english: That World-Honored One, the Tathagata Medicine Master Vaiḍūrya Light, when practicing the Bodhisattva Path, made twelve great vows, causing all sentient beings to obtain whatever they seek.

chinese: 「第一大願：願我來世得阿耨多羅三藐三菩提時，自身光明，熾然照曜無量無數無邊世界，以三十二大丈夫相、八十隨，莊嚴其身；令一切有情，如我無異。
english: "The First Great Vow: When I attain anuttara-samyak-sambodhi in a future lifetime, may my own body be radiant with light, blazing and illuminating immeasurable, countless, and boundless worlds, adorned with the thirty-two marks of a great man and eighty secondary characteristics; and may all sentient beings become like me, without any difference."

chinese: 「第二大願：願我來世得菩提時，身如琉璃，內外明徹，淨無瑕穢，光明廣大，功德巍巍，身善安住，焰網莊嚴，過於日月；幽冥眾生，悉蒙開曉，隨意所趣，作諸事業。
english: "The Second Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in my future life, may my body be like lapis lazuli, transparent both within and without, pure and free from all defilement and blemish. May my light be vast and brilliant, my merit towering and sublime. May my body be well-established and adorned with a net of radiance, surpassing the sun and moon. May all sentient beings in darkness and gloom be illuminated and enlightened, and may they accomplish all tasks according to their inclinations."

chinese: 「第三大願：願我來世得菩提時，以無量無邊智慧方便，令諸有情，皆得無盡所受用物，莫令眾生有所乏少。
english: "The Third Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future life, may I, through immeasurable and boundless wisdom and skillful means, cause all sentient beings to obtain inexhaustible resources for enjoyment and use, so that no sentient being shall ever lack anything."

chinese: 「第四大願：願我來世得菩提時，若諸有情行邪道者，悉令安住菩提道中；若行聲聞獨覺乘者，皆以大乘而安立之。
english: "The Fourth Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future lifetime, may all sentient beings who follow the heterodox paths be established in the Bodhisattva path; and may all those who practice the vehicles of the Śrāvaka and Pratyekabuddha be established in the Great Vehicle."

chinese: 「第五大願：願我來世得菩提時，若有無量無邊有情，於我法中修行梵行，一切皆令得不缺戒，具三聚戒。
english: "The Fifth Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future life, if there are immeasurable and infinite sentient beings who practice the brahmacharya in my Dharma, I will cause all of them to attain flawless precepts and perfect the three categories of precepts."

chinese: 設有毀犯，聞我名已，還得清淨，不墮惡趣。
english: If there are those who commit transgressions, yet upon hearing my name, they shall attain purification and not fall into evil destinies.

chinese: 「第六大願：願我來世得菩提時，若諸有情，其身下劣，諸根不具，醜陋、頑愚、盲、聾、瘖、瘂、、躄、背僂、白癩、癲狂、種種病苦；聞我名已，一切皆得端正黠慧。
english: "The Sixth Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future lifetime, may all sentient beings whose bodies are inferior, whose faculties are incomplete, who are ugly, foolish, blind, deaf, mute, dumb, lame, humpbacked, afflicted with leprosy, insane, and suffering from all manner of diseases—upon hearing my name, may they all obtain proper form and keen wisdom."

chinese: 諸根完具，無諸苦。
english: All the faculties are complete and perfect, without any suffering.

chinese: 「第七大願：願我來世得菩提時，若諸有情，眾病逼切，無救無歸，無醫無藥，無親無家，貧窮多苦，我之名號，一經其耳，病悉除，身心安樂，家屬資具，悉皆豐足，乃至證得無上菩提。
english: "The Seventh Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future lifetime, for all sentient beings who are afflicted by various diseases, having no salvation and no refuge, no physicians and no medicine, no relatives and no family, suffering from poverty and much hardship—if my name enters even once into their ears, may all their diseases be eliminated, their body and mind find peace and joy, their families and material resources all become abundant and sufficient, until they ultimately attain supreme Bodhi."

chinese: 「第八大願：願我來世得菩提時，若有女人，為女百惡之所逼惱，極生厭離，願捨女身；聞我名已，一切皆得轉女成男，具丈夫相，乃至證得無上菩提。
english: "The Eighth Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future lifetime, if there are women oppressed and tormented by the hundred evils of being female, who feel intense revulsion and wish to abandon their female form, upon hearing my name, may they all be able to transform from female to male, possess the characteristics of a man, and ultimately attain supreme Bodhi."

chinese: 「第九大願：願我來世得菩提時，令諸有情，出魔羂網，解脫一切外道纏縛；若墮種種惡見稠林，皆當引攝置於正見，漸令修習諸菩薩行，速證無上正等菩提。
english: "The Ninth Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future life, may I enable all sentient beings to escape the demon's snare and be liberated from all the bonds of heterodox teachings. Those who have fallen into the dense forests of various evil views shall all be guided and brought to right view, gradually led to cultivate the practices of the Bodhisattvas, and swiftly attain the supreme, perfect enlightenment."

chinese: 「第十大願：願我來世得菩提時，若諸有情，王法所鞭撻，繫閉牢獄，或當戮，及餘無量災難，悲愁煎迫，身心受苦；若聞我名，以我福德威神力故，皆得解脫一切憂苦。
english: "The Tenth Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future lifetime, if there are sentient beings who are flogged by royal law, imprisoned and shackled, or about to be executed, and those suffering from immeasurable other calamities, tormented by sorrow and anguish, their bodies and minds undergoing suffering; if they hear my name, then through the power of my merit and spiritual might, they shall all be liberated from all anxieties and sufferings."

chinese: 「第十一大願：願我來世得菩提時，若諸有情，飢渴所惱，為求食故造諸惡業；得聞我名，專念受持，我當先以上妙飲食，飽足其身；後以法味，畢竟安樂而建立之。
english: "The Eleventh Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future lifetime, if sentient beings are troubled by hunger and thirst, and commit various evil deeds in seeking food, upon hearing my name and single-mindedly remembering and upholding it, I shall first satisfy their bodies with supreme and wonderful food and drink; thereafter, I shall establish them in ultimate peace and happiness through the flavor of the Dharma."

chinese: 「第十二大願：願我來世得菩提時，若諸有情，貧無衣服，蚊虻寒熱，晝夜逼惱；若聞我名，專念受持，如其所好，即得種種上妙衣服，亦得一切寶莊嚴具，華鬘塗香，鼓樂眾伎，隨心所翫，皆令滿足。
english: "The Twelfth Great Vow: When I attain Bodhi in a future life, if sentient beings are impoverished and lack clothing, troubled day and night by mosquitoes, insects, cold and heat; if they hear my name and single-mindedly uphold it in their thoughts, then according to whatever they desire, they shall immediately obtain all kinds of supreme and wonderful garments. They shall also attain all precious ornaments and adornments, flower garlands and fragrant unguents, drums and musical instruments and various performances. According to their heart's desires, all shall be completely satisfied."

chinese: 「曼殊室利！
english: "Manjushri!

chinese: 是為彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來、應、正等覺，行菩薩道時，所發十二微妙上願。
english: This constitutes the twelve subtle and supreme vows that the World-Honored One, the Tathagata Medicine Master of Lapis Lazuli Light, the Worthy One and Perfectly Enlightened One, made while practicing the bodhisattva path.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Manjushri!

chinese: 彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來，行菩薩道時所發大願，及彼佛土功德莊嚴，我若一劫，若一劫餘，說不能盡。
english: That World-Honored One, the Tathagata Medicine Master of Lapis Lazuli Light, when practicing the bodhisattva path, made great vows, and the merits and adornments of that Buddha land—even if I were to explain for one kalpa or more than one kalpa, I could not exhaust them.

chinese: 然彼佛土，一向清淨，無有女人，亦無惡趣，及苦音聲。
english: Nevertheless, in that Buddha's land, it is purely clean in every respect, without women, without evil destinies, and without the sounds of suffering.

chinese: 琉璃為地，金繩界道，城、闕、宮、閣、軒、窓、羅網，皆七寶成。
english: The ground was made of lapis lazuli, with golden cords marking the paths. The cities, gates, palaces, pavilions, halls, windows, and latticed networks were all made of the seven treasures.

chinese: 亦如西方極樂世界，功德莊嚴，等無差別。
english: It is also like the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, where merits and virtues adorn it equally without any distinction.

chinese: 於其國中，有二菩薩摩訶薩：一名日光遍照，二名月光遍照，是彼無量無數菩薩眾之上首，能持彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來正法寶藏。
english: In that land, there are two great bodhisattvas: one named Sunlight Illumination, and the second named Moonlight Illumination. These are the foremost among the countless multitude of bodhisattvas, and they are able to uphold the treasury of the true dharma of that World-Honored One, the Tathagata Medicine Master of Lapis Lazuli Light.

chinese: 是故，曼殊室利！
english: Therefore, Manjushri!

chinese: 諸有信心善男子、善女人等，應當願生彼佛世界。
english: All faithful good men and good women should aspire to be born in that Buddha's world.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊復告曼殊利童子言：「曼殊室利！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One again spoke to the Bodhisattva Manjushri, saying: "Manjushri!

chinese: 有諸眾生，不識善惡，唯懷貪悋，不知布施及施果報，愚癡無智，闕於信根，多聚財寶，勤加守護；見乞者來，其心不喜，設不獲已而行施時，如割身肉，深生痛惜。
english: There are sentient beings who do not recognize good and evil, harboring only greed and stinginess, who do not understand giving and the fruits of giving, foolish and lacking wisdom, deficient in the root of faith. They accumulate much wealth and diligently guard it; when they see a beggar come, their hearts are displeased. Even when compelled by circumstances to give, it is as if cutting flesh from their own bodies, and they feel deep pain and regret.

chinese: 復有無量慳貪有情，積集資財，於其自身尚不受用，何況能與父母、妻子、奴婢、作使，及來乞者？
english: Moreover, there are countless miserly and greedy sentient beings who accumulate wealth and property, yet do not even enjoy it themselves—how much less could they give to their parents, wives, children, servants, slaves, and those who come begging?

chinese: 彼諸有情，從此命終，生餓鬼界，或生趣。
english: Those sentient beings, when their lives end here, are reborn in the realm of hungry ghosts, or in that realm of existence.

chinese: 由昔人間，曾得暫聞藥師琉璃光如來名故，在惡趣，暫得憶念彼如來名，即於念時，從彼處沒，還生人中，得宿命念，畏惡趣苦，不樂欲樂，好行惠施，讚歎施者，一切所有悉無貪惜，漸次尚能以頭目手足，血肉身分，施來求者，況餘財物。
english: In past lives, people had the opportunity to hear the name of the Tathagata Medicine King of Lapis Lazuli Light, even if only briefly. Consequently, when reborn in evil destinies, upon merely recollecting the name of that Tathagata during such recollection, they immediately depart from that place and are reborn among humans. They gain the recollection of past lives, fear the suffering of evil destinies, take no delight in sensual pleasures, delight in practicing generosity, praise those who give, and regard all their possessions without attachment or stinginess. Gradually, they are even able to give their head, eyes, hands, feet, blood, flesh, and bodily parts to those who request them, much less would they withhold other material possessions.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利，若諸有情，雖於如來受諸學處，而破尸羅；有雖不破尸羅，而破軌則；有於尸羅、軌則，雖得不壞，然毀正見；有雖不毀正見，而棄多聞，於佛所說契經深義不能解了；有雖多聞而上慢，由增上慢覆蔽心故，自是非他，嫌謗正法，為魔伴黨。
english: "Moreover, Manjusri, if there are sentient beings who, although they have received the precepts from the Tathagata, break the discipline; some do not break the discipline but break the rules of conduct; some, though they preserve intact both discipline and rules of conduct, yet destroy right view; some, though they do not destroy right view, yet abandon extensive learning and are unable to understand the profound meaning of the sutras spoken by the Buddha; some, though they have extensive learning, yet are arrogant, and because their minds are obscured by arrogance, they regard themselves as right and others as wrong, disdain and slander the true dharma, and become companions of Mara."

chinese: 如是愚人，自行邪見，復令無量俱胝有情，墮大險坑。
english: "Such a foolish person, through their own practice of wrong views, also causes immeasurable countless sentient beings to fall into a great precipice of danger."

chinese: 此諸有情，應於地獄、傍生、鬼趣，流轉無窮。
english: These sentient beings should circulate endlessly in the realms of hell, animals, and hungry ghosts.

chinese: 若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號，便捨惡行，修諸善法，不墮惡趣，設有不能捨諸惡行，修行善法，墮惡趣者，以彼如來本願威力，令其現前暫聞名號，從彼命終還生人趣，得正見精進，善調意樂，便能捨家趣於非家，如來法中，受持學處，無有毀犯；正見多聞，解甚深義，離增上慢，不謗正法，不為魔，漸次修行諸菩薩行，速得圓滿。
english: If one is able to hear the name of the Tathagata Medicine Master, the Lapis Lazuli Light, one will immediately abandon evil conduct and practice all wholesome dharmas, and will not fall into the evil destinies. Even if there are those who are unable to abandon evil conduct and practice good dharmas and fall into the evil destinies, by the power of that Tathagata's fundamental vow, his name will be heard before them, and from the end of that life they will be reborn in the human realm. Having obtained right view and diligence, with their minds well-disciplined and delighted, they will be able to leave home and enter the homeless life. In the Tathagata's dharma, they will receive and uphold the precepts, without any transgression. With right view and much learning, understanding profound meanings, free from arrogance and conceit, not slandering the correct dharma, not becoming a demon, gradually practicing all the bodhisattva practices, they will quickly attain perfection.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Manjushri!

chinese: 若諸有情，慳貪嫉妬，自讚毀他，當墮三惡趣中，無量千歲受諸劇苦；受劇苦已，從彼命終，來生人間，作牛、馬、駝、驢，恒被鞭撻，飢渴逼惱；又負重，隨路而行。
english: If sentient beings are stingy and jealous, praise themselves and disparage others, they will fall into the three evil destinies and suffer intense torments for countless thousands of years. After suffering these intense torments, when their lives end there, they are reborn in the human realm as oxen, horses, camels, or donkeys, constantly beaten with whips, harassed by hunger and thirst, and made to carry heavy burdens while traveling along roads.

chinese: 或得為人，生居下，作人奴婢，受他驅役，恒不自在。
english: Or one might be reborn as a human, but be born in a lowly position, becoming a servant or slave to others, constantly subjected to their command, never free to act as one wishes.

chinese: 若昔人中，曾聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，由此善因，復憶念，至心歸依。
english: If in the past among people there were those who once heard the name of the World-Honored One, the Medicine Master of Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, through this wholesome cause, they further recollect and mindfully take refuge with sincere hearts.

chinese: 以佛神力，眾苦解脫，諸根聰利，智慧多聞，恒求勝法，常遇善友，永斷魔羂，破無明，竭煩惱河，解脫一切生、老、病、死，憂、苦惱。
english: By the Buddha's spiritual power, all suffering is liberated; the faculties become keen and sharp, wisdom and learning become abundant; one constantly seeks the supreme dharma, perpetually encounters virtuous friends, forever severs the demon's snare, breaks ignorance, exhausts the river of afflictions, and achieves liberation from all birth, aging, sickness, death, sorrow, and suffering.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Manjushri!

chinese: 若諸有情，好憙乖離，更相鬪訟，惱亂自他，以身語意，造作增長種種惡業，展轉常為不饒益事，互相謀害。
english: If sentient beings delight in discord and separation, constantly quarreling and litigating with each other, disturbing and agitating themselves and others, and through body, speech, and mind create and increase all manner of unwholesome karma, progressively always engaging in affairs that bring no benefit, and mutually scheming to harm one another.

chinese: 告召山林樹塚等神；殺諸眾生，取其血肉，祭祀藥叉剎等；書怨人名，作其形像，以惡呪術而呪之；厭媚蠱道，呪起屍鬼，令斷彼命，及壞其身。
english: Summoning the deities of mountains, forests, trees, and burial mounds; slaughtering various living beings and taking their blood and flesh to make offerings to yakṣas, rākṣasas, and the like; writing the names of those one resents and fashioning their likenesses, cursing them with evil incantations; employing witchcraft and sorcery to enchant and bewitch, raising corpses and ghosts through curses to sever their lives and destroy their bodies.

chinese: 是諸有情，若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號，彼諸惡事，悉不能害。
english: All sentient beings, if they can hear the name of the Tathagata Medicine Master and Lapis Lazuli Light, shall not be harmed by those various evil things.

chinese: 一切展轉皆起慈心，利益安樂，無損惱意及嫌恨心；各各歡悅，於自所受生於喜足，不相侵，互為饒益。
english: All transformations and turnings arise from a compassionate heart, benefiting and bringing happiness, without any intention of harm, disturbance, or resentment and hatred. Each and every one is delighted, rejoicing in satisfaction with what they themselves receive, not encroaching upon one another, and mutually providing benefit to each other.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Manjushri!

chinese: 若有四眾：苾芻、苾芻尼、鄔波索迦、鄔波斯迦，及餘淨信善男子、善女人等，有能受持八分齋戒，經一年，或復三月，受持學處，以此善根，願生西方極樂世界無量壽佛所，聽聞正法，而未定者。
english: If there are among the four assemblies—monks, nuns, laymen, and laywomen—and other pure-faithful good men and good women who are able to uphold the eight precepts of the fasting discipline for one year or three months, practicing the training rules, and who, by means of these roots of goodness, wish to be born in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss in the presence of the Buddha of Immeasurable Life to hear the true dharma, yet whose resolve is not yet firm.

chinese: 若聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，臨命終時，有八薩，來，示其道路，即於彼界種種雜色眾寶華中，自然化生。
english: If one hears the name of the Bhagavat Medicine Master Vaidurya Light Tathagata, at the time when life is ending, eight bodhisattvas will come and show the way. Immediately in that land, one will spontaneously be born transformed among the various multicolored jeweled flowers.

chinese: 或有因此生於天上，雖生天中，而本善根亦未窮盡，不復更生諸餘惡趣。
english: Some are born in heaven because of this; although they are born in the heavens, their fundamental good roots are not yet exhausted, and they will not be reborn again in the various other evil destinies.

chinese: 天上壽盡，還生人間，或為輪王，統攝四洲，威德自在，安立無量百千有情於十善道；或生剎帝利、婆羅門、居士大家，多饒財寶，倉庫盈溢，形相端嚴，眷屬具足，聰明智慧，勇健威猛，如大力士。
english: When their lifespan in heaven is exhausted, they are reborn in the human realm. Some become Wheel-turning Kings who govern the four continents, possessing sovereign power and virtue, establishing immeasurable hundreds of thousands of sentient beings in the ten wholesome paths. Others are born as Kshatriyas, Brahmins, or wealthy householders with abundant treasures, overflowing storehouses, excellent physical forms, complete retinues, keen intelligence and wisdom, brave and vigorous disposition, like mighty warriors of great strength.

chinese: 若是女人，得聞世尊藥師名號，至心受持，於後不復更受女身。
english: If it is a woman who hears the name of the Bhagavat Medicine Buddha and accepts and upholds it with sincere devotion, she shall not receive a female body again in the future.

chinese: 」時，曼殊室利童子白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the boy Manjushri spoke to the Buddha, saying: "World Honored One!

chinese: 我當誓於像法轉時，以種種方便，令諸淨信善男子、善女人等，得聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號，乃至睡中亦以佛名覺悟其耳。
english: During the time of the counterfeit dharma, I make this vow that through various expedient means I shall cause all the faithful, virtuous men and virtuous women to hear the name of the World-Honored One, the Medicine Master and King of Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, and even in sleep I shall awaken their ears with the Buddha's name.

chinese: 世尊！
english:
Bhagavat!

(Or: Blessed One! / World-Honored One!)

chinese: 若於此經受持讀誦，或復為他演說開示；若自書，若人書；恭敬尊重，以種種花香、塗香、香、燒香、花鬘、瓔珞、幡蓋、伎樂，而為供養；以五色綵，作囊盛之；掃灑淨處，敷設高座，而用安處。
english: If one receives and upholds this sutra, reads and recites it, or expounds and explains it to others for their sake; whether one writes it oneself or has others write it; treating it with reverence and respect, making offerings to it with various kinds of flowers, incense, fragrant oils, burning incense, flower garlands, ornamental necklaces, banners and canopies, and musical performances; wrapping it in five-colored brocade and placing it in a silk bag; sweeping and sprinkling clean places, spreading out elevated seats, and setting it upon them.

chinese: 爾時，四大天王與其眷屬，及餘無量百千天眾，皆詣其所，供養守護。
english: At that time, the Four Great Heavenly Kings, together with their retinues, and countless other hundreds of thousands of celestial beings, all came to that place to make offerings and provide protection.

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若此經寶流行之處，有能受持，以彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來本願功德，及聞名號，當知是處無復橫死；亦復不為諸惡鬼神，奪其精氣；設已奪者，還得如故，身心安樂。
english: If in any place where this scripture-treasure circulates, there are those who can uphold and maintain it, by the vows and merit of the World-Honored One, the Tathagata Medicine Master Vaiḍūrya Light, and by hearing his name, you should know that in such a place there will be no more untimely deaths; moreover, one will not be deprived of one's vital essence by evil ghosts and spirits; and if it has already been taken, one will recover it as before, with body and mind at peace and ease.

chinese: 」佛告曼殊室利：「如是！
english: The Buddha told Manjushri: "It is so!

chinese: 如是！
english: "Indeed!" or "So it is!"

chinese: 如汝所說。
english: "Just as you have said."

chinese: 曼殊室利！
english: Manjushri!

chinese: 若有淨信善男子、善女人等，欲供養彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來者，應先造立彼佛形像，敷清淨座而安處之；散種種花，燒種種香，以種種幢幡莊嚴其處；七日七夜，受八分齋戒，食清淨食，澡浴香潔，著新淨衣，應生無垢濁心，無怒害心，於一切有情，起利益安樂，慈、悲、喜、捨，平等之心，鼓樂歌讚，右繞佛像。
english: If there are faithful lay practitioners, both male and female, who wish to make offerings to that World-Honored One, the Buddha of Medicine King with Lapis Lazuli Radiance, they should first construct and establish an image of that Buddha, arrange a pure seat and place it thereon. They should scatter various flowers, burn various incenses, and adorn the place with various banners and streamers. For seven days and seven nights, they should observe the eight-fold precepts, consume pure food, bathe in fragrant cleanliness, and wear newly laundered garments. They should generate a mind free from defilement and turbidity, free from anger and harm, and toward all sentient beings, cultivate a mind of benefit and happiness, with loving-kindness, compassion, sympathetic joy, and equanimity—all equal. They should play musical instruments and sing praises, while circumambulating the Buddha image to the right.

chinese: 復應念彼如來本願功德，誦此經，思惟其義，演說開示。
english: One should in return contemplate that Tathagata's original vow and merit, recite this sutra, reflect upon its meaning, and expound and reveal it to others.

chinese: 隨所樂，一切皆遂：求長壽得長壽，求富饒得富饒，求官位得官位，求男女得男女。
english: Following one's desires, all things are fulfilled: those who seek longevity attain longevity, those who seek wealth attain wealth, those who seek official position attain official position, those who seek sons and daughters attain sons and daughters.

chinese: 若復有人，忽得惡夢，見諸惡相，或怪鳥來集，或於住處，百怪出現；此人若以眾妙資，恭敬供養彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來者，惡夢惡相，諸不吉祥，皆悉隱沒，不能為患。
english: If again there is a person who suddenly has a bad dream, sees various inauspicious signs, or strange birds come to gather, or in their dwelling place, a hundred strange phenomena appear; if this person, with various wonderful offerings and respectful veneration, makes offerings to that Bhagavat, the Tathagata Medicine Master Vaidurya Light, then the bad dreams, inauspicious signs, and all unlucky omens will completely disappear and be unable to cause harm.

chinese: 或有水、火、刀、毒、懸嶮、惡象、師子、虎、狼、熊、羆、毒蛇、惡蠍、蜈蚣、蚰、蚊虻等怖；若能至心憶念彼佛，恭敬供養，一切怖畏皆得解脫。
english: Or if there be terrors from water, fire, swords, poison, precipices and steep cliffs, fierce elephants, lions, tigers, wolves, bears, wild boars, poisonous snakes, scorpions, centipedes, mukkaraṭas, mosquitoes, and gadflies—if one can wholeheartedly remember that Buddha with reverence and make offerings, all such fears and terrors shall be completely liberated from.

chinese: 若他國侵擾，盜賊反亂；憶念恭敬彼如來者，亦皆解脫。
english: If other countries invade and disturb, or bandits and rebels arise, those who recall and respect that Tathagata shall also all be liberated.

chinese: 「復次，曼殊室利！
english: "Furthermore, Manjushri!

chinese: 若有淨信善男子、善女人等，乃至盡形不事餘天，當一心歸佛、法、僧，受持禁戒，若五戒、十戒、菩薩四百戒、苾芻二百五十戒、苾芻尼五百戒，於所受中或有毀犯，怖墮惡趣，若能專念彼佛名號，恭敬供養者，必定不受三惡趣生。
english: If there are men and women of pure faith and virtue, who throughout their lives do not serve other deities, but with single-minded devotion take refuge in the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Sangha, uphold the precepts, whether the Five Precepts, the Ten Precepts, the Bodhisattva Four Hundred Precepts, the Bhikku Two Hundred Fifty Precepts, or the Bhikkunī Five Hundred Precepts, and among those precepts they have received, should there be any transgressions, fearing they will fall into evil destinies, if they are able to single-mindedly recollect that Buddha's name and respectfully make offerings, they will surely not receive rebirth in the three evil destinies.

chinese: 或有女人，臨當產時，受於極苦；若能至心稱名禮讚，恭敬供養彼如來者，眾苦皆除。
english: There are women who, when approaching the time of childbirth, undergo extreme suffering. If they can, with utmost sincerity, call upon the name, bow in reverence, and praise that Tathāgata with respectful offerings, all their sufferings will be entirely removed.

chinese: 所生之子，身分具足，形色端正，見者歡喜，利根聰明，安隱少病，無有非人，奪其精氣。
english: The sons born to her will have complete status, proper form and appearance, delight all who see them, keen faculties and sharp intelligence, peace and freedom from illness, and will not be harmed by non-humans who would steal their vital essence.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊告阿難言：「如我稱揚彼佛世尊藥師琉璃光如來所有功德，此是諸佛甚深行處，難可解了，汝為信不？
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to Ananda: "As I praise all the merits of that Buddha, the World-Honored One, the Tathagata of Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light, this is the profound practice of all Buddhas, difficult to understand and comprehend. Do you have faith in this?"

chinese: 爾時，勝軍大王坐一面已，而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: At that time, the Great King Victorious-in-Battle, being seated to one side, spoke to the Buddha, saying: "O World-Honored One of Great Compassion!

chinese: 願如來哀愍教授，惟願善逝哀愍教誡，令我長夜證於大義利益安樂。
english: May the Tathagata have compassion and instruct me; may the Sugata have compassion and teach me, so that I may throughout the long night realize the great meaning, benefit, and happiness.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊告大王曰：「善哉，善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to the great king: "Excellent, excellent!

chinese: 大王！
english: Your Majesty!

chinese: 汝今乃能請問如來如是大義。
english: You are now able to ask the Tathagata about such great meanings.

chinese: 大王！
english: Your Majesty!

chinese: 汝今為大國主，應以正法勿以邪法，應隨法行勿隨非法。
english: You are now the ruler of a great nation. You should govern with righteous law and not with unrighteous law. You should follow the dharma and not follow what is contrary to the dharma.

chinese: 所以者何？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 若有國王或諸王等，棄捨正法以諸邪法而作國王，彼於現在為諸聖賢之所訶毀，後致憂悔，身壞命終墮諸惡趣，生地獄中受諸劇苦；又若國王或諸王等，棄捨邪法以其正法而作國王，彼於現在為眾聖賢之所稱讚，後無憂悔，身壞命終超昇善趣，生諸天中受諸妙樂。
english: If there are kings or rulers who abandon righteous dharma and govern using various heterodox doctrines, they are reproached and condemned by the sages and virtuous in the present life. Subsequently they experience regret, and when their bodies perish and life ends, they fall into evil destinies and are born in hell where they endure severe suffering. Moreover, if there are kings or rulers who abandon heterodox doctrines and govern using righteous dharma, they are praised and commended by the multitude of sages and virtuous in the present life. Subsequently they experience no regret, and when their bodies perish and life ends, they ascend to fortunate destinies and are born among the heavenly realms where they enjoy sublime bliss.

chinese: 「大王！
english: "Great King!

chinese: 譬如父母憐愍於子，心常欲令離苦得樂；王亦應爾，於諸國邑所有眾生，僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，應以諸佛所說四攝而受之。
english: For instance, parents have compassion for their children and constantly wish to enable them to leave suffering and attain happiness. A king should likewise be thus: toward all sentient beings in the various states and cities under his rule—servants, laborers, ministers, and officials—he should receive and govern them according to the Four Methods of Attraction taught by all the Buddhas.

chinese: 何等為四？
english: "What are the four?"

chinese: 一者、布施；二者、愛語；三者、利行；四者、同事。
english: First, giving; second, kind speech; third, beneficial conduct; fourth, cooperating action.

chinese: 如是善攝國邑眾生，僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，攝於二義同事同歸。
english: Thus, a virtuous ruler governs the state and its people, servants, laborers, ministers, and officials, uniting them through two principles: common enterprise and common destination.

chinese: 何等二義？
english: What are these two meanings?

chinese: 一者、現在；二者、未來。
english: One is the present; two is the future.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 譬如男子或諸女人，於其夢中夢心所見，可愛園林可愛山谷，可愛國邑并諸異類，彼夢覺已所見皆無。
english: For example, men or various women, in their dreams see with their dreaming mind beloved gardens, beloved valleys, beloved cities and various other things. When they awaken from that dream, all that they saw is non-existent.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "It is so, Great King!"

chinese: 國祚身命虛偽無常，一切皆如夢之所見。
english: The fortune of the state and one's life are false and impermanent; all things are like what is seen in a dream.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步諸軍宮殿，后妃太子諸王，輔臣僚佐防衛士眾，父母兄弟姊妹妻妾，男女大小僮僕作使國邑眾生，金銀珍寶末尼真珠，衣服財穀庫藏等物，如是所有諸欲樂具，於命終時皆當棄捨，獨往後世無一相隨。
english: The king's wealth and happiness, the king's freedom and happiness, the king's sensual pleasures, and all other sensual pleasures and enjoyments—namely, elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, various armies, palaces, queens, crown princes, various princes, ministers, officials, guards, soldiers, fathers, mothers, brothers, sisters, wives, concubines, male and female servants both great and small, servants and laborers, people of the realm, gold, silver, precious gems, pearls, clothing, grain, treasuries, and stored goods—all such sensual pleasures and enjoyments as these must all be abandoned at the time of death, and one goes alone into the next life with not a single thing accompanying one.

chinese: 「大王知！
english: "The great king knows!"

chinese: 如上所說一切樂具，非常非恒不可保信，皆變易法迅速不停，流轉移動終歸壞滅，念念遷謝後為灰燼，究竟同趣滅盡之門，是失壞法有諸怖畏、有諸災橫、多諸愁惱，皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之。
english: All the pleasant things mentioned above are impermanent and unreliable; they are all subject to change, swift and never ceasing. They flow and shift, ultimately ending in decay and destruction. Moment by moment they pass away, finally becoming ashes. In the end, they all tend toward the gateway of utter extinction. This is the law of deterioration, fraught with terrors, disasters, and calamities, bringing much sorrow and affliction—all leading to ruin, dissolution, decline, breaking apart, and separation.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 譬如樹林先見開華，尋復結果後還無果，先見其葉榮茂青翠，尋復萎黃後皆凋落。
english: For instance, a forest first shows blossoms opening, but soon afterward bears fruit and later has no fruit at all; first one sees its leaves luxuriant and verdant, but soon afterward they wither and yellow, and finally all scatter and fall.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "Indeed, Great King!"

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The state's fortune and one's body and life, the king's wealth, honor, and pleasure, the king's autonomy and pleasure, the king's sensual pleasures, and all other desirable pleasures and enjoyments—namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, and other armies—extensively explained and extending to all these are dharmas of falling, decay, deterioration, breakage, and separation; thus it is likewise.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty must understand!

chinese: 如大火聚，先見熾然復極熾然，轉遍熾然後皆洞然，雖久熾盛終歸滅盡。
english: Like a great fire gathering, first appearing blazingly then becoming even more blazing, turning to spread blazingly throughout before all becomes transparent and clear, though it burns intensely for long, it ultimately returns to complete extinction.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "Indeed, Great King!"

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The fortune of the state and one's life span—the king's wealth, prosperity, and happiness, the king's autonomy and happiness, the king's sensual pleasures, and all other various pleasures and enjoyments, namely elephants, horses, carriages, infantry, and other troops—when elaborately explained, all of these are dharmas subject to decay, ruin, deterioration, destruction, separation, and dispersal. It is likewise so.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know this!

chinese: 如日月輪，有大神用具大勢力，放大光明以自莊嚴，遍照世間終歸隱沒。
english: Like the wheels of the sun and moon, great deities use great powers and force, emitting vast radiance to adorn themselves, illuminating the world everywhere, yet ultimately vanishing into obscurity.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: Thus, great king!

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The state's destiny and one's body and life, the king's wealth, fortune, and happiness, the king's autonomy and happiness, the king's sensual pleasures, and all other various pleasures and enjoyments—namely elephants, horses, chariots, infantry, and other troops—if elaborated extensively, all of these are subject to falling away, decline, destruction, and dispersal. It is likewise so.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 譬如大雲遍覆虛空，暴風疾雷掣電注雨，震動天地須臾散滅。
english: Like a great cloud covering the entire sky, with violent winds, swift thunder, lightning flashing, and rain pouring down, shaking heaven and earth, then suddenly scattering and disappearing.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "It is so, Great King!"

chinese: 國祚身命，王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂，及餘所諸欲樂具，所謂象馬車步軍等，廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法，亦復如是。
english: The state's fortune and one's life span, the king's wealth, honor, and happiness, the king's autonomy and happiness, the king's pleasure of desire, and all other requisites of pleasures—namely, elephants, horses, chariots, infantry and other troops, and so forth, extensively explained up to all of these—are likewise laws of falling, decay, ruin, destruction, separation, and dispersal.

chinese: 是故，大王！
english: Therefore, great king!

chinese: 應善勤修，隨無常觀、隨盡滅觀，於自命終常當驚懼，為大國王應以正法勿以非法，應隨法行勿隨非法。
english: One should cultivate diligently, practice the contemplation of impermanence, practice the contemplation of cessation and extinction. As one's life draws to an end, one should constantly be fearful and apprehensive. A great king should govern with righteous law and not with unrighteous law. One should follow the dharma and not follow what is contrary to the dharma.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 如四大山從四方來，牢固堅密無有缺漏無諸間隙，周匝充遍總一合成，上盡虛空下窮地際，其中所有一切草木枝條花葉，及諸有情蠢動之類皆被磨滅，難以決勇而可逃避，難以勢力而能抗拒，難以呪術財貨藥物而可禁止。
english:
# Translation

Just as four great mountains come from the four directions, firm, solid, and dense with no gaps or crevices, surrounding and completely filling [the space], joining together as one, reaching up to exhaust the void and down to the limits of the earth—everything within it, all grasses, trees, branches, flowers, and leaves, as well as all sentient beings and moving creatures, are all ground to destruction. [This is] difficult to escape through courage, difficult to resist through force, difficult to prevent through spells, wealth, or medicine.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "So it is, great king!"

chinese: 世有四種大怖畏事，各來磨滅一切眾生，難以決勇而可逃避，難以勢力而能抗拒，難以呪術財貨藥物而能禁止。
english: There are four great fearful things in the world that come to wear down all living beings. They cannot be escaped through courage, cannot be resisted through power, and cannot be prevented through spells, wealth, or medicine.

chinese: 「云何四種大怖畏事？
english: "What are the four kinds of great fearful things?

chinese: 大王當知！
english:
"Your Majesty must know!"

or

"Great King, you should know!"

chinese: 一者、老來逼害，磨滅眾生少壯；二者、病來逼害，磨滅眾生調適；三者、死來逼害，磨滅眾生壽命；四者、衰來逼害，磨滅眾生興盛。
english: First, old age comes as oppression and harm, wearing away the youth and vigor of sentient beings; second, illness comes as oppression and harm, wearing away the well-being and comfort of sentient beings; third, death comes as oppression and harm, wearing away the lifespan of sentient beings; fourth, decline comes as oppression and harm, wearing away the prosperity and flourishing of sentient beings.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 譬如師子為眾獸王，入鹿群中搏取一鹿，若噉未噉自在無難。
english: For example, just as a lion, being the king of beasts, enters a herd of deer and seizes one deer, whether it eats it or not, it does so freely and without difficulty.

chinese: 其鹿爾時先所騰勇，入師子口無復能為。
english: At that time, the deer's former vigor and courage were exhausted, and it could no longer do anything when entering the lion's mouth.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "It is so, Great King!"

chinese: 一切眾生既入無常師子王口，所有勢力無復能為。
english: All sentient beings, having entered the mouth of the Lion King of Impermanence, have no remaining power to do anything.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 譬如有人勇健多力毒箭所中，一切威猛皆悉摧滅。
english: For example, a person of great courage and strength, struck by a poisoned arrow, will have all their vigor and prowess utterly destroyed.

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "Indeed, O great king!"

chinese: 一切眾生剛強戾，死箭所中無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，臨欲捨命解支節時，血肉枯竭心胸熱惱，焦渴所逼張口大息，手足紛亂無所堪能，無有勢力涎涕交流，大小便利穢污身體，六根閉塞喉喘息急，良醫拱手棄諸妙藥。
english:
# Translation

All sentient beings, rigid and violent in nature, when struck by the arrow of death lose all power and protection, have nowhere to take refuge, nowhere to escape. When about to abandon life and their limbs begin to separate, their blood and flesh dry up, their hearts and chests grow hot and troubled. Parched with thirst, they gasp with open mouths, their hands and feet thrash about without control, bereft of all strength. Saliva and nasal mucus flow profusely, their bowels and bladder lose control, fouling their bodies. Their six sense-faculties close off, their throats gasp and breath comes fast. Even the skilled physician folds his hands in surrender, abandoning all his miraculous medicines.

chinese: 其所飲噉美味珍饌無不悉捨，偃臥床枕臨往異趣淪沒無際，生老病死無常流，至臨終位餘命無幾，業有力故後有現前。
english: All the delicious foods and rare delicacies that he consumed, he completely abandoned. Lying on bed and pillow, he approached a different realm, sinking into the boundless. The inexorable flow of birth, aging, sickness, and death—when reaching the end of life with but little time remaining, the force of karma manifests, and the subsequent existence appears before him.

chinese: 甚大怖畏琰魔王使，廣大黑闇夜分所吞，出息入息最後將滅，唯獨一身無有第二及餘伴侶，奄背此生歸於後世。
english: I greatly fear the messenger of Yama, the king of the dead. The vast and dark night will swallow me. My outgoing and incoming breaths will finally cease. Alone, I have no second body, no other companions. Suddenly leaving this life, I depart to the next world.

chinese: 是大移轉趣大叢林，入大黑闇遊大曠野，泛大溟海業風所飄，往無標記冥方所，當於爾時無異救護、無異歸依、無異投竄，唯除正法。
english: It is a great transition toward the great forest thicket, entering into great darkness roaming the great wasteland, floating upon the great sea of the cosmos drifted by the winds of karma, going toward unmarked destinations in the dark directions. At that time there is no other savior, no other refuge, no other place of sanctuary, save only the True Dharma.

chinese: 大王！
english: "Great King!"

chinese: 彼於爾時，唯有正法能為救、能為宮室、能作歸依，是所奔趣是所投竄，能拔眾生出生死苦。
english: At that time, the Dharma alone could serve as salvation, could serve as a palace, could serve as refuge. It was that toward which [all] rushed, that into which [all] took shelter, [and it was able to] pull sentient beings out of the suffering of birth and death.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty must know this!"

chinese: 譬如有人寒苦所逼，有煖火日光衣等，所能止息而可獲安；熱苦所逼林泉等；若涉遠道清涼陰；若渴所逼清冷水；若飢所逼多美膳，若病所逼惟良醫藥及供侍者；若怖所逼惟強伴侶。
english: For example, if a person is tormented by cold suffering, warmth from fire, sunlight, and clothing can alleviate it and bring comfort; if tormented by heat suffering, forests and springs [bring relief]; if one undertakes a long journey, cool shade provides relief; if tormented by thirst, clear cold water [brings relief]; if tormented by hunger, abundant delicious food [brings relief]; if tormented by illness, only good physicians, medicine, and attendants [bring relief]; if tormented by fear, only strong companions [bring relief].

chinese: 如是，大王！
english: "Thus, Great King!"

chinese: 一切眾生死箭所中，無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，臨欲捨命解支節時，血肉枯竭心胸熱惱，焦所逼張口，手足紛亂無所堪能，廣說乃至彼於爾時唯有正法，能為救護、能為宮室、能作歸依，是所奔趣是所投竄，能拔眾生出生死苦。
english: All sentient beings are struck by the arrow of death, without further power, without further protection, without anything to rely upon, without anywhere to take refuge. When they are about to abandon their lives and their limbs dissolve, their blood and flesh wither, their hearts and chests burn with anguish, pressed by distress they open their mouths, their hands and feet thrash about without any capacity to act. Speaking extensively of all this—at that time, for them, only the correct Dharma can provide protection, can provide shelter, can serve as refuge. It is what they rush toward, it is where they take cover, and it is able to pull sentient beings out of the suffering of birth and death.

chinese: 所以者何？
english: "What is the reason for this?" or "Why is this so?"

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "The Great King should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖加守護雖久洗飾，雖以眾多上妙飲食恣意飽滿，及至臨終，要當不免飢渴所逼而便捨命。
english: This body, though protected and maintained, though long cleansed and adorned, though abundantly satisfied with many excellent and delicious foods according to one's desires, when death finally arrives, must inevitably suffer the torment of hunger and thirst before giving up its life.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "The Great King should know this!

chinese: 如是身者，雖常澡浴，塗香末香香花鬘隨意嚴飾，由此自體穢漏成故，臨捨命時，終必歸於不淨臭穢。
english: "Such a body, though constantly bathed, anointed with fragrant oils and powders, adorned with fragrant garlands and flowers as one wishes, because this very substance is inherently impure and leaking, when the time comes to abandon life, it must inevitably return to filth and foul decay."

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖以種種上妙衣服覆蔽纏裹，由此自身諸不淨物所合成故，於命終時，要當不淨種種流出。
english: The body being such, although it may be covered and wrapped with all manner of fine and excellent garments, since it is composed of various impurities of this very body, at the time of death, all manner of impure substances must inevitably flow out.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖處宮室后妃婇女內美人眷屬圍遶，作眾伎樂種種倡，以自娛樂歡喜快樂，臨命終時，自見惡相，要當驚怖憂悲苦惱。
english: Such a body, though dwelling in palaces and mansions surrounded by consorts, concubines, and beautiful women of the inner quarters, and though engaging in various entertainments and performances of all kinds to amuse and delight itself with joy and happiness, at the moment of death's approach will inevitably see evil omens and must experience terror, sorrow, grief, and suffering.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Great King, you should know!

chinese: 如是身者，雖處宮室綵飾畫殿閣樓臺，戶牖軒窓重密掩，種種香花以自嚴飾，種種燈燭光照明，施設珍奇屏障帷幄，燒眾名香散諸妙花，香花寶瓶處處陳列，安置種種金銀琉璃眾寶床座，敷設上妙氍錦繡文蓐花氈，床座兩頭俱置丹枕，覆以上妙綺帊錦衾，寤寐安寢歡娛耽著，於命終後無所覺知，或屍骸置於葬所，烏鵲鵰鷲狐狼野干，餓狗鵄梟諸惡禽獸爭共食噉，骨肉膿血鬚髮糞穢，流溢地上臭處可惡。
english: Such a body, although it dwells in palaces with ornate decorations, painted halls, towers and pavilions, with windows and openings closely sealed, adorned with various fragrant flowers, illuminated by numerous lamps and candles with bright light, furnished with rare and precious screens and curtains, with many fine incenses burned and wonderful flowers scattered, with fragrant flowers and precious vases arranged everywhere, provided with various beds and seats of gold, silver, lapis lazuli and other treasures, with the finest tapestries, embroidered fabrics, flower-patterned felts laid out, with red pillows placed at both ends of the bed, covered with the finest silk damask quilts, resting in comfort and contentment day and night—after the end of life it knows nothing. Or the corpse is placed in a burial ground where crows, magpies, eagles, vultures, foxes, wolves, jackals, hungry dogs, kites and owls and various evil beasts contend with one another to devour and consume it, with bones, flesh, pus, blood, hair and filth flowing and overflowing on the ground in a putrid and repulsive place.

chinese: 「大王當知！
english: "Your Majesty should know!

chinese: 爾時，世尊告文殊師利菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One spoke to the Bodhisattva Mañjuśrī, saying: "Excellent!

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent! / Well said! / Splendid!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩諮詢如來因地法行，及為末世一切眾生求大乘者，得正住持不墮邪見。
english: "You are thus able to consult the Tathagata concerning the dharma practices of bodhisattvas during the causal ground, and for all sentient beings in the final age who seek the Great Vehicle, you obtain correct upholding so as not to fall into heterodox views."

chinese: 汝今諦聽！
english: Listen carefully now!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: "I shall now explain this for you."

chinese: 」時，文殊師利菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, the Bodhisattva Manjushri joyfully received the teaching, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good man!

chinese: 無上法王有大陀羅尼門，名為圓覺，流出一切清淨真如菩提涅槃及教授菩薩。
english: The Supreme Dharma King possesses a great dharani gate named Perfect Enlightenment, from which flows forth all pure Suchness, Bodhi, Nirvana, and the teachings that instruct bodhisattvas.

chinese: 一切如來本起因地，皆依圓照清淨覺相，永斷無明方成佛道。
english: All Tathagatas, in their original causal ground, all rely upon the perfectly illuminating pure aspect of awareness, and only by permanently severing ignorance is the Buddha path accomplished.

chinese: 云何無明？
english: "What is ignorance?"

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 一切眾生從無始來種種顛倒，猶如迷人四方易處，妄認四大為自身相，六塵緣影為自心相；譬彼病目見空中花及第二月。
english: All sentient beings from beginningless time have been deluded in various ways, like a confused person for whom the four directions are interchanged. They falsely take the four great elements as the characteristics of their own body, and the reflected images of the six sense-objects as the characteristics of their own mind. This is like a diseased eye seeing flowers in empty space and a second moon.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 空實無花，病者妄執。
english: The sky is actually without flowers; the sick person deludes himself with attachments to them.

chinese: 由妄執故，非唯惑此虛空自性，亦復迷彼實花生處，由此妄有輪轉生死，故名無明。
english: Due to deluded attachment, not only is the intrinsic nature of empty space obscured, but also the actual place where flowers are born is confused. Through this delusion, there is illusory transmigration and the cycle of birth and death; therefore it is called ignorance.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 此無明者非實有體，如夢中人夢時非無，及至於醒了無所得；如眾空花滅於虛空，不可說言有定滅處，何以故？
english: This ignorance has no substantial reality. Like a person in a dream who is not non-existent while dreaming, yet upon awakening there is nothing to be obtained; like the flowers in the sky that disappear into emptiness—one cannot say there is a definite place of extinction. Why is this?

chinese: 無生處故。
english:
"Because there is no place of birth."

or

"Because of the absence of origination."

chinese: 一切眾生於無生中，妄見生滅，是故說名輪轉生死。
english: All sentient beings, within the non-arising, falsely perceive arising and cessation; therefore it is said they transmigrate through the cycle of birth and death.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 如來因地修圓覺者，知是空花，即無輪轉，亦無身心受彼生死，非作故無，本性無故。
english: The Tathagata, in practicing perfect enlightenment during the causal stage, knows that these are empty flowers. Thus there is no transmigration, and neither body nor mind undergoes birth and death. This is not non-existence because of cessation, but rather because of original non-existence in the nature itself.

chinese: 彼知覺者猶如虛空，知虛空者即空花相，亦不可說無知覺性。
english: He who knows is like empty space; he who knows empty space manifests as illusory flowers; yet one cannot say there is an absence of the nature of knowing.

chinese: 有、無俱遣，是名為淨覺隨順。
english: "Both existence and non-existence are relinquished; this is called pure awakening in accordance."

chinese: 何以故？
english: Why is this so?

chinese: 虛空性故，常不動故，如來藏中無起滅故，無知見故，如法界性究竟圓滿遍十方故；是則名為因地法行。
english: Because of emptiness-nature, because of constant non-movement, because within the Tathāgatagarbha there is no arising and ceasing, no knowing and seeing, and because it is ultimately complete and pervades the ten directions like the nature of the dharma-realm—this is called the dharma practice of the causal ground.

chinese: 菩薩因此於大乘中發清淨心，末世眾生依此修行不墮邪見。
english: The bodhisattva therefore generated a pure mind in the Great Vehicle, and sentient beings of the final age who practice according to this will not fall into false views.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊欲重宣此義而說偈言：「文殊汝當知，一切諸如來，從於本因地，皆以智慧覺，了達於無明。
english:
At that time, the World-Honored One, wishing to restate this meaning, spoke in verse:

"Manjushri, you should know that all the Tathagatas, from their original causal ground, all attained awakening through wisdom and thoroughly understood ignorance."

chinese: 知彼如空花，即能免流轉，又如夢中人，醒時不可得。
english: Understanding others as illusory flowers in the sky, one can thus escape the cycle of rebirth. Just as a person in a dream cannot be found when awakened.

chinese: 覺者如虛空，平等不動轉，覺遍十方界，即得成佛道。
english:
The awakened one is like empty space,
Impartial and unmoved by transformation,
Awareness pervades the ten directions of all realms,
Thus one attains the Buddha way.

chinese: 眾幻滅無處，成道亦無得，本性圓滿故。
english: All illusions vanish without trace, enlightenment is also nothing to attain, because the original nature is already complete.

chinese: 菩薩於此中，能發菩提心，末世諸眾生，修此免邪見。
english:
The Bodhisattva in this can awaken the Bodhi heart;
The sentient beings of the final age who cultivate this will be free from perverted views.

chinese: 」於是普賢菩薩在大眾中即從座起，頂禮佛足右遶三匝，長跪叉手而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: Then Samantabhadra Bodhisattva rose from his seat in the midst of the great assembly, prostrated at the Buddha's feet, circumambulated three times to the right, knelt with palms joined, and addressed the Buddha, saying: "Great Compassionate World-Honored One!

chinese: 願為此會諸菩薩眾，及為末世一切眾生修大乘者，聞此圓覺清淨境界，云何修行？
english: I wish to ask on behalf of all the bodhisattvas assembled in this gathering, and for the sake of all sentient beings in the final age who practice the Mahayana: How should one cultivate and practice upon hearing this perfectly enlightened, pure realm of the Surangama Sutra?

chinese: 世尊！
english: "World-Honored One!"

chinese: 若彼眾生，知如幻者，身心亦幻，云何以幻還修於幻？
english: If those sentient beings know that all is illusory, then body and mind are also illusory—how can one use illusion to cultivate illusion?

chinese: 若諸幻性，一切盡滅，無有心，誰為修行？
english: If all illusory natures were completely extinguished and there were no mind, who would practice?

chinese: 云何復說修行如幻？
english: How, then, is practice explained to be illusory?

chinese: 若諸眾生本不修行，於生死中常居幻化，曾不了知如幻境界，令妄想心云何解脫？
english: If sentient beings do not cultivate practice from the beginning, they constantly dwell in illusion within the cycle of birth and death, never understanding the illusory nature of all phenomena. How can their deluded minds be liberated?

chinese: 願為末世一切眾生，作何方便漸次修習，令諸眾生永離諸幻。
english: I wish to devise what expedient means should be gradually cultivated for all sentient beings in the final age, so that all sentient beings may forever be separated from all delusions.

chinese: 」作是語已五體投地，如是三請終而復始。
english: "After speaking these words, [he] prostrated with all five limbs touching the ground. Thus the three requests were completed and began again repeatedly."

chinese: 爾時，世尊告普賢菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One addressed Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, saying: "Excellent!

chinese: 善哉！
english: "Excellent!" or "Very good!"

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩及末世眾生，修習菩薩如幻三昧，方便漸次，令諸眾生得離諸幻。
english: You are able to cultivate for all bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final dharma age the bodhisattva samadhi of illusory appearances, gradually leading them through expedient means so that all sentient beings attain liberation from all illusions.

chinese: 汝今諦聽！
english: Listen carefully now!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: "I shall now explain this for you."

chinese: 」時，普賢菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva received the teaching with joy, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good man!

chinese: 一切眾生種種幻化，皆生如來圓覺妙心，猶如空花從空而有，幻花雖滅空性不壞；眾生幻心還依幻滅，諸幻盡滅覺心不動。
english: All sentient beings, through various illusory transformations, are born from the Tathagata's perfectly awakened, wondrous mind. It is like flowers in space arising from space itself. Although illusory flowers may disappear, the nature of space remains unharmed. The illusory minds of sentient beings likewise depend upon illusion for their dissolution. When all illusions are completely exhausted, the awakened mind remains unmoved.

chinese: 依幻說覺亦名為幻，若說有覺猶未離幻，說無覺者亦復如是。
english:
# Translation

According to the illusory doctrine, awakening is also called illusion. If one says there is awakening, one has still not departed from illusion. If one says there is no awakening, it is likewise the same.

chinese: 是故，幻滅名為不動。
english: Therefore, the extinction of illusion is called immobility.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good man!

chinese: 一切菩薩及末世眾生，應當遠離一切幻化虛妄境界，堅執持遠離心故，心如幻者亦復遠離，遠離為幻亦復遠離，離遠離幻亦復遠離，得無所離即除諸幻。
english: All bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age should distance themselves from all illusory and false realms. By firmly maintaining the mind of detachment, the mind that is like illusion is also to be abandoned. The abandonment that is itself illusion is also to be abandoned. The abandonment of the abandonment of illusion is also to be abandoned. When there is nothing to abandon, all illusions are eliminated.

chinese: 譬如鑽火兩木相因，火出木盡灰飛煙滅；以幻修幻亦復如是，諸幻雖盡不入斷滅。
english: It is like drilling fire with two pieces of wood that depend on each other—when the fire comes out, the wood is exhausted and the ashes fly away in smoke and disappear. Similarly, cultivating illusion by means of illusion is also thus: though all illusions are exhausted, it does not fall into annihilation.

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good men!

chinese: 知幻即離，不作方便；離幻即覺，亦無漸次。
english: Knowing illusion is immediate liberation; no skillful means are needed. Being freed from illusion is immediate enlightenment; there is also no gradual progression.

chinese: 一切菩薩及末世眾生依此修行，如是乃能永離諸幻。
english: All bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age, by practicing in accordance with this, shall thus be able to eternally transcend all illusions.

chinese: 」爾時，世尊欲重宣此義而說偈言：「普賢汝當知，一切諸眾生，無始幻無明，皆從諸如來，圓覺心建立。
english:
At that time, the World-Honored One, wishing to restate this meaning, spoke in verse:

"Know this, Samantabhadra: all sentient beings,
From beginningless illusory ignorance,
Are all established by the Tathagatas
From the perfect enlightenment mind.

chinese: 猶如虛空花，依空而有相，空花若復滅，虛空本不動。
english: Like flowers in empty space, they manifest depending on space, yet when the flowers in emptiness perish, empty space itself remains fundamentally unmoved.

chinese: 幻從諸覺生，幻滅覺圓滿，覺心不動故。
english: Illusions arise from various perceptions; illusions cease when perception is complete, because the perceiving mind does not move.

chinese: 若彼諸菩薩，及末世眾生，常應遠離幻，諸幻悉皆離。
english: If those bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age constantly distance themselves from illusions, then all illusions will be entirely transcended.

chinese: 如木中生火，木盡火還滅，覺無漸次，方便亦如是。
english: As fire generated in wood—when the wood is exhausted, the fire likewise extinguishes—awakening has no gradual stages; expedient means are similarly thus.

chinese: 」於是普眼菩薩在大眾中即從座起，頂禮佛足右遶三匝，長跪叉手而白佛言：「大悲世尊！
english: Then the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra rose from his seat in the midst of the great assembly, prostrated at the Buddha's feet, circumambulated three times to the right, knelt with palms joined, and spoke to the Buddha, saying: "Great Compassionate World-Honored One!

chinese: 願為此會諸菩薩眾及為末世一切眾生，演說菩薩修行漸次，云何思惟？
english: "I wish to expound for all the bodhisattvas assembled in this gathering, and for all sentient beings in the final age, the gradual steps of bodhisattva practice—what is the method of contemplation?"

chinese: 云何住持？
english: How should one maintain [the practice]?

chinese: 眾生未悟作何方便普令開悟？
english: "What expedient means should be employed so that all sentient beings, not yet enlightened, may universally attain enlightenment?"

chinese: 世尊！
english: World-Honored One!

chinese: 若彼眾生無正方便及正思惟，聞佛如來說此三昧心生迷悶，於圓覺不能悟入。
english: If those sentient beings lack the correct expedient means and correct contemplation, upon hearing the Buddha Tathagata expound this samadhi, their minds will become confused and perplexed, and they will be unable to awaken to and enter the perfect enlightenment.

chinese: 願興慈悲，為我等輩及末世眾生假說方便。
english: Please manifest compassion and expound provisional teachings for us and for all sentient beings of the final age.

chinese: 」作是語已五體投地，如是三請終而復始。
english: "After speaking these words, he prostrated with his five limbs touching the ground. Thus the three requests were repeated in this manner, beginning again."

chinese: 爾時，世尊告普眼菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the World-Honored One said to the Bodhisattva Universal-Eye: "Excellent!

chinese: 善哉！
english: Excellent!

chinese: 善男子！
english: Good men!

chinese: 汝等乃能為諸菩薩及末世眾生，問於如來修行漸次、思惟、住持乃至假說種種方便，汝今諦聽！
english: You are able to ask the Tathagata on behalf of all the bodhisattvas and the sentient beings of the final dharma age about the gradual stages of practice, contemplation, abiding, and even the various expedient means that are provisionally expounded. Listen carefully now!

chinese: 當為汝說。
english: "I shall now explain this for you."

chinese: 」時，普眼菩薩奉教歡喜，及諸大眾默然而聽。
english: At that moment, the Bodhisattva Puyanduo joyfully received the teaching, and all the great assembly listened in silence.

chinese: 「善男子！
english: "Good man!

chinese: 彼新學菩薩及末世眾生，欲求如來淨圓覺心，應當正念遠離諸幻，先依如來奢摩他行，堅持禁戒，安處徒眾，宴坐室，作是念：『我今此身四大和合，所謂髮毛、爪齒、皮肉、筋骨、髓腦、垢色皆歸於地，唾涕、膿血、津液、涎沫、痰淚、精氣、大小便利皆歸於水，暖氣歸火，動轉歸風。
english: For those new bodhisattvas and sentient beings of the final age who wish to seek the Tathagata's pure and perfect enlightened mind, they should cultivate right mindfulness and distance themselves from all illusions. First, they should rely on the Tathagata's practice of shamatha, firmly maintain the precepts, and settle peacefully among the sangha. Sitting in solitude in a room, they should contemplate thus: "This body of mine is composed of the four great elements. Hair, nails, teeth, skin, flesh, sinews, bones, marrow, and brain—all these return to earth. Saliva, mucus, pus, blood, fluids, phlegm, tears, vital essence, and the discharges of excretion all return to water. Warmth returns to fire, and movement returns to wind.

chinese: 四大各離，今者妄身當在何處？
english: "When the four elements separate, where can this delusional body possibly be?"

chinese: 其樹有種種葉，如真多摩尼。
english: Its tree has leaves of various kinds, like true maṇi jewels.

chinese: 樹形於上繫種種繒綵，或繫吠瑠璃寶天菓妙衣，或垂雲降雨。
english: Bright trees above are adorned with all manner of silken ribbons and colored cloths. Some are hung with lapis lazuli jewels, celestial fruits, and wonderful garments, while others pour down clouds and rain.

chinese: 有種種芽，吉祥眾鳥並坐其上。
english: There are all kinds of sprouts, and auspicious birds of various species sit together upon them.

chinese: 或於枝間種種寶葉已成劫樹，世尊兩肩後倚著其樹。
english: Or among the branches, all kinds of precious leaves had already become a kalpa tree, and the World-Honored One leaned his back against this tree at his two shoulders.

chinese: 佛右邊座下畫轉輪王形，坐白蓮華，作觀佛勢。
english: To the right of the Buddha, beneath the seat, paint the form of a Wheel-turning King, seated on a white lotus, in an attitude of contemplating the Buddha.

chinese: 其身金色，周遍光明，七寶成就，惟輪寶以光圍繞在蓮華上。
english: His body is golden in color, radiating light in all directions. Adorned with the seven treasures, only the wheel treasure, surrounded by radiance, rests upon the lotus.

chinese: 餘六寶如次安之。
english: The remaining six treasures are arranged as follows.

chinese: 東南角摧碎佛頂南勝佛頂西南角無邊聲佛頂西白傘蓋佛頂西北角高廣佛頂北光聚佛頂東北角最勝佛頂正東高佛頂已上中院。
english: The southeastern corner: Shattered Buddha Crown; south: Southern Victory Buddha Crown; southwestern corner: Boundless Sound Buddha Crown; west: White Parasol Buddha Crown; northwestern corner: Lofty and Expansive Buddha Crown; north: Light Gathering Buddha Crown; northeastern corner: Supreme Victory Buddha Crown; due east: Lofty Buddha Crown. The above comprises the inner courtyard.

chinese: 次第二院獨古杵界道。
english:
# Translation

The second division in sequence: the Lone Ancient Pestle Realm Path.

chinese: 東南角法波羅蜜菩薩次大勢至觀音菩薩葉衣觀音菩薩多羅觀音菩薩觀世音菩薩毘俱胝觀音菩薩白衣觀音菩薩觀自在王菩薩西南角羯磨波羅蜜菩薩次禪波羅蜜菩薩忍波羅蜜菩薩施波羅蜜菩薩虛空明妃戒波羅蜜菩薩精進波羅蜜菩薩惠波羅蜜菩薩西北角金剛波羅蜜菩薩次降三世金剛菩薩金剛將明妃金剛將童子金剛手菩薩金剛母菩薩蘇婆呼童子菩薩頂行童子菩薩同前東北角寶波羅蜜菩薩次般若波羅蜜菩薩慈氏菩薩佛慈菩薩佛眼菩薩佛豪相菩薩文殊菩薩如意寶菩薩已上第二院。
english: In the southeast corner: the Bodhisattva Dharma Paramita, followed by Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Leaf-Clothed Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Tara Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Viśvamukhi Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, White-Robed Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, and Avalokiteshvara-Raja Bodhisattva. In the southwest corner: the Bodhisattva Karma Paramita, followed by the Bodhisattva Dhyana Paramita, the Bodhisattva Patience Paramita, the Bodhisattva Generosity Paramita, the Dakini of Void Luminosity, the Bodhisattva Discipline Paramita, the Bodhisattva Diligence Paramita, and the Bodhisattva Wisdom Paramita. In the northwest corner: the Bodhisattva Vajra Paramita, followed by the Bodhisattva Trailokyavijaya Vajra, the Vajra General Dakini, the Vajra General Youth, the Bodhisattva Vajrapani, the Bodhisattva Vajra Mother, the Youth Bodhisattva Subhahuva, and the Youth Bodhisattva Crowned and Practicing. In the northeast corner: the Bodhisattva Jewel Paramita, followed by the Bodhisattva Prajña Paramita, the Bodhisattva Maitreya, the Bodhisattva Buddha's Compassion, the Bodhisattva Buddha's Eye, the Bodhisattva Buddha's Remarkable Features, the Bodhisattva Manjushri, and the Bodhisattva Wish-Fulfilling Jewel. The above constitutes the Second Court.

chinese: 次第三院同第二界道。
english: "The third stage follows the same path as the second realm."

chinese: 東南角歌供養菩薩次如意輪菩薩纔發心轉法輪菩薩八聖觀音菩薩蓮華吉祥菩薩蓮華孫陀利菩薩青頸觀音菩薩蓮華髻菩薩蓮華藥叉菩薩十一面觀音菩薩西南角舞供養菩薩次嚩哩迦龍王嚩哩迦七頭阿難陀龍王無染河天者地天供養無能勝姤菩薩無能勝妃無熱惱龍王目真鱗龍王龍女西北角獻喜菩薩次烏芻瑟摩金剛金剛藏菩薩甘露軍吒利菩薩金剛孫陀利菩薩金剛愛菩薩金剛拳菩薩施無畏菩薩鉢拏攝末里菩薩金剛針菩薩東北角鬘供養菩薩談無竭菩薩陀羅尼自在菩薩摩麼鷄菩薩大惠菩薩寂靜菩薩無垢惠菩薩虛空無垢菩薩海惠菩薩善象猛菩薩已上第三院。
english: In the southeast corner, the Singing Offering Bodhisattva; next are Wish-Fulfilling Wheel Bodhisattva, Wheel-Turning Dharma Bodhisattva, Eight Holy Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Lotus Auspicious Bodhisattva, Lotus Sundari Bodhisattva, Green Neck Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, Lotus-Knot Bodhisattva, Lotus Yaksha Bodhisattva, and Eleven-Faced Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva. In the southwest corner, the Dancing Offering Bodhisattva; next are Varika Dragon King, Seven-Headed Ananda Dragon King, Undefiled River Deva, Earth Deva, the Undefeatable Guhya Bodhisattva and his consort, the Non-Tormented Dragon King, Mukti-Scale Dragon King, and the Dragon Maiden. In the northwest corner, the Joyful Offering Bodhisattva; next are Ucchusma Vajra, Vajra Treasury Bodhisattva, Amrta Army Kuntali Bodhisattva, Vajra Sundari Bodhisattva, Vajra Love Bodhisattva, Vajra Fist Bodhisattva, Fearlessness-Bestowing Bodhisattva, Patra Samavari Bodhisattva, and Vajra Needle Bodhisattva. In the northeast corner, the Garland Offering Bodhisattva; next are Inexhaustible Talk Bodhisattva, Dharani Sovereign Bodhisattva, Momaqi Bodhisattva, Great Wisdom Bodhisattva, Quiescence Bodhisattva, Immaculate Wisdom Bodhisattva, Void-Space Immaculate Bodhisattva, Ocean Wisdom Bodhisattva, and Virtuous Elephant Fierce Bodhisattva. The above completes the Third Court.

chinese: 金剛界外第四院辦事天等次第外供養從東南角燈供養菩薩次火天姤焰魔天王當門金剛鈴菩薩次焰魔王姤羅剎天主西南角塗香菩薩次羅剎主姤毘沙門天王當門金剛鉤菩薩次毘沙門天姤風天主西北角香供養菩薩風天姤水天王當門金剛索菩薩水天姤伊舍那天東北角花供養菩薩伊舍那天姤帝釋天王當門金剛鎖菩薩帝釋姤火天主已上第四院。
english: The outer fourth court of the Vajradhatu: the procedure of the administrative deities and outer offerings. Beginning from the southeast corner: lamp offering bodhisattva; next, Agni (fire deity) paired with Yama, the king of death; at the gate, vajra bell bodhisattva; next, Yama paired with the lord of rakshasas. Southwest corner: incense offering bodhisattva; next, the lord of rakshasas paired with Vaisravana; at the gate, vajra hook bodhisattva; next, Vaisravana paired with the wind deity. Northwest corner: fragrance offering bodhisattva; next, the wind deity paired with the water king; at the gate, vajra rope bodhisattva; next, the water deity paired with Isana. Northeast corner: flower offering bodhisattva; next, Isana paired with Indra; at the gate, vajra lock bodhisattva; next, Indra paired with the fire deity. The above concludes the fourth court.

chinese: 從此第五食道院，四角畫五古杵契，焰鬘威相成。
english: From this fifth esophageal courtyard, the four corners are painted with five ancient pestle seals, and the flaming garland fierce aspect is completed.

chinese: 已上曼荼羅輪王大灌頂儀軌中上壇聖者，都計一百二十二尊號。
english: The above mandala wheel-turning king great initiation ritual's upper altar deities total one hundred twenty-two names.

chinese: 阿闍梨與弟子灌頂，應於大曼荼羅側、對聖眾面前，別塗作曼荼羅。
english: The master and disciple, during the ritual empowerment, should construct a separate mandala by applying pigments on the side of the great mandala, facing the assembly of the sacred community.

chinese: 以白粉參肘量，普於中畫蓮花。
english: With white powder and ginseng measured by the elbow, lotus flowers are commonly depicted in the middle of the painting.

chinese: 中台上畫師子座，令灌頂弟子花了者坐上，令一解法弟子持蓋及拂誦吉慶聲讚徐徐不絕。
english: On the central platform was painted a lion throne, upon which sat a disciple who had received abhiseka with flowers scattered upon them. A dharma-expounding disciple held a canopy and a whisk, chanting auspicious blessing verses continuously without interruption.

chinese: 取中瓶水加持一百八遍。
english: Take water from a middle-sized bottle and empower it one hundred and eight times.

chinese: 教弟子結佛頂印安於頂上，然須吹擊鼓作諸音樂等。
english: Instruct the disciples to form the Buddha's Crown Seal and place it on the crown of the head. However, one must blow [into instruments], beat drums, and create various musical sounds and the like.

chinese: 我今依經說，輪王畫像法，近人具眾流，作法方可為，如經廣稱述，白疊須頓方，五肘或三肘。
english: I present this according to the scripture: the method of painting the image of a wheel-turning king. The person nearby should gather all the traditions. The method of creation can then be accomplished. As the scripture extensively describes, white cloth must be cut square, five cubits or three cubits.

chinese: 畫聖者像，先從大海踊出須彌山王，四寶所成，於山上坐白蓮華，身白金色，正受入最勝王三摩地，結跏趺坐。
english: Paint the image of the sage: First, Mount Sumeru, the king of mountains, emerges leaping from the great ocean, composed of four precious substances. Upon the mountain sits a white lotus flower, upon which [the figure] with a white golden body is properly absorbed in the supreme victorious king samadhi, seated in the lotus posture.

chinese: 從一切身遍滿流出十二幅金輪熾盛光明。
english: From the entire body everywhere flows forth twelve wheels of gold, blazing with brilliant radiance.

chinese: 於上應畫山峯，其峯以種種寶成。
english: Upon the upper [part], one should paint mountain peaks, with those peaks formed from various kinds of jewels.

chinese: 聖者從頂流出種種光明，青黃赤白旋轉自在。
english: The sage emits various rays of light from the crown, rotating freely in blue, yellow, red, and white.

chinese: 聖者右邊畫持誦人，手執香爐，觀如來面。
english: On the right side of the sage is painted a person holding a sutra, grasping an incense burner in hand, gazing upon the face of the Tathagata.

chinese: 下應畫蓮花池。
english: Below should be painted a lotus pond.

chinese: 畫二大明王，相如後說。
english: "Paint two great Wisdom Kings, as will be explained afterwards."

chinese: 尊儀賀野仡哩嚩大明王，身如火色，忿怒形，鼻如猿猴，以蛇莊嚴，瓔珞臂釧膊釧，頭繫蓮華鬘，作瞻睹勢。
english: Revered and honored Maharaja of Great Brightness, with a body of fiery color, wrathful in form, a nose like that of a monkey, adorned with serpents, wearing necklaces, armlets, and bracelets, with a lotus garland bound upon the head, in a gazing posture.

chinese: 次無能勝忿怒王，身白色，四臂，頻眉面嗔。
english: Next is Incapable of Being Overcome, the Wrathful King, whose body is white in color, with four arms, knitted brows, and a wrathful expression on his face.

chinese: 虎皮為裙，蟒蛇為耳璫，得叉迦龍王以為腰，縚婆蘇枳龍王以為神線，角絡被耽肚。
english: Tiger skin as a skirt, python snake as ear pendants, obtained the fork-tusk dragon king to serve as a belt, the Suvarnasūtra dragon king to serve as divine thread, antler netting draped upon the belly.

chinese: 身形稍短，以毒蛇莊嚴髻冠，口咬下唇，遍身火焰熾盛圓光，右上手持金剛杵，右下手作期尅勢，左上手持三古戟叉，左下手執鉞斧。
english: His body is somewhat short. He is adorned with a headdress of poisonous snakes, biting his lower lip. His entire body is surrounded by blazing flames and a circular halo. His upper right hand holds a vajra, his lower right hand makes a threatening gesture. His upper left hand holds a three-pronged trident, his lower left hand wields an axe.

chinese: 正面作阿吒吒賀娑勢，從口火焰種種色相，右邊面作觀瞻勢，左邊面下看也，頭上面作觀大眾勢。
english: The front face assumes the gesture of Atata Hasashotoku, with flames of various colors emanating from the mouth. The right face assumes the gesture of gazing upon, the left face gazes downward, and the upper face on the head assumes the gesture of observing the great assembly.

chinese: 於寶蓮華立也了。
english:
"Upon the precious lotus, [it] was established and completed."

Or more naturally: "It was established and completed upon the precious lotus."

chinese: 已上二聖者於曼荼羅門外兩邊畫。
english: The two above-mentioned saints are painted on both sides outside the mandala gate.

chinese: 次觀本尊五支也。
english: "Next, observe the five limbs of the principal deity."

chinese: 阿尾囉吽欠阿字微字囉字吽字欠字。
english: Aum hūṃ phaṭ. A syllable, vi syllable, ra syllable, hūṃ syllable, phaṭ syllable.

chinese: 五支先布已，次說瑜伽相：阿字真金色，普現金剛輪，加持於下體，說名瑜伽座。
english:
# Translation

The five supports have already been arranged. Next, the characteristics of yoga are explained: The letter 'A' is truly golden in color, universally manifesting the vajra wheel, conferring empowerment upon the lower body, is called the yoga seat.

chinese: 微字素月光，匪於霧聚中，加持於齊上，是名大悲海。
english: The infinitesimal character embodies moonlight; not gathered within mist, empowerment is added above the equanimous, this is called the Great Compassion Ocean.

chinese: 囉字初日暉，形赤在三角，加持於心位，稱為智火威。
english: The character Lo at dawn's first light, with form red in the triangle, maintained in the heart position, is called the wisdom fire majesty.

chinese: 吽字劫火焰，塗玄若風輪，加持白毫際，名為自在力。
english: The syllable Hūṃ's conflagration, smeared as dark as a wind wheel, empowered at the white hair-curl's extremity, is named the power of self-mastery.

chinese: 欠字由大空，含容一切色，加持於頂上，故號無等人。
english: The character of "absence" originates from vast emptiness, embracing and containing all forms. With empowerment upon the crown, it is therefore called the Incomparable One.

chinese: 次五支從地水火風空配成及壇。
english: The next five branches are configured and arranged in a mandala according to earth, water, fire, wind, and space.

chinese: 阿字想座下，金剛座已成，色相如黃金，即戒義也。
english: The meditator visualizes the syllable "A" beneath, and the Vajra Seat is formed. Its appearance is like gold, which represents the meaning of precepts.

chinese: 其壇相方，曼荼囉亦耳。
english: Its altar configuration is likewise a mandala.

chinese: 微字想於臍，色白慈悲水，即定義也。
english: The word "subtle" is contemplated at the navel; its color is white, the water of compassion, which is precisely the definition of concentration.

chinese: 其壇相圓，外壇如滿月。
english: Its altar is circular in shape, with the outer altar resembling a full moon.

chinese: 囉字想於心，其相色赤紅，為惠義也。
english: The character "Lo" is contemplated in the mind; its appearance is reddish-red in color, signifying the meaning of benefit and righteousness.

chinese: 其壇三角形，外壇亦三角。
english: Its altar is triangular in shape, and the outer altar is also triangular.

chinese: 吽字想眉間，色黑，為無礙風，即解脫義也，其壇想青形如半月，外壇相亦同。
english: Contemplate the syllable "hūṃ" between the eyebrows, dark in color, as the unobstructed wind, which signifies liberation. Its maṇḍala is imagined as blue in form like a half-moon, and the outer maṇḍala appearance is likewise the same.

chinese: 欠字安頂上，以成大空點，即解脫知見義也。
english: The deficient character at the top, by completing the great void point, immediately clarifies the meaning of liberation and understanding.

chinese: 其壇如字義，空點無色相，能成諸事業，即是陀羅尼義也。
english: The mandala, in accordance with its literal meaning, is empty of characteristics and devoid of form at its focal point, yet it is capable of accomplishing all activities. This is precisely the meaning of dharani.

chinese: 唵速乞灑摩嚩日囉唵底瑟姹嚩日囉唵薩頗囉拏嚩日囉唵僧賀囉嚩日囉次說畫蘇婆呼童子身形眷屬。
english: Om svaha samavajra om tishtha vajra om saphara na vajra om samhara vajra. Next, depict the form and retinue of Subahu, a youth.

chinese: 尊身如童子形，金色如名號，悚慄畫尊儀，七曜圍繞。
english: Revere the body in the form of a child, golden in color as befits the name, trembling as the venerable image is painted, surrounded by the seven luminaries.

chinese: 密莫雲漠、嗢沒斯、那纈鷄，各如本形畫，住賀野仡哩嚩明側，立花上。
english: The dense clouds and mist, the Umosisi, and the patterned rooster, each painted according to their original forms, dwell in Heyaye Kiliva brightness on the side, standing upon flowers.

chinese: 次畫頂行童子身形眷屬。
english: Next, paint the figure of a child at the top with its retinue/attendants.

chinese: 尊身金色，髻髮下垂，左手持金剛杵，右手叉腰，八頻那夜迦圍繞所為。
english: The body is golden in color, with hair arranged in a topknot hanging down. The left hand holds a vajra, the right hand is placed on the hip, and [the figure] is surrounded by eight Gaṇapati attendants.

chinese: 金剛莊嚴、金剛塵、金剛索、金剛鉞斧、金剛極笑、金剛成莊嚴、金剛頂、金剛頻那夜，釰器仗如文配。
english: Vajra Adornment, Vajra Dust, Vajra Rope, Vajra Battle-axe, Vajra Extreme Laughter, Vajra Accomplished Adornment, Vajra Peak, Vajra Pinaka Night—weapons and implements as arranged in the text.

chinese: 已上並是頂輪壇法，具足寫了。
english: "The above is all the Dharma of the Crown Chakra Mandala, completely written out."

chinese: 天喜元年五月一日書了一交了僧賴昭以天台實嚴僧正持本交合之東寺沙門道快此軌者弘和尚集歟？
english: On the first day of the fifth month of Tenki 1, [I] wrote and handed [this] over to the monk Raishō. Regarding the Tendai Shikan text held by Monk-administrator Jitsugon, [I] handed [it] over in agreement to the East Temple Monk Dōkai. Is this perhaps a compilation by Hirokawa the Abbot?

chinese: 辨兩字通用之間。
english: Distinguish between the interchangeability of two characters.

chinese: 青龍和尚門人制作，尤以可為規模者也。
english: The disciples of the monk Qinglong made this, and it is particularly worthy of serving as a model.

chinese: 至明旦己，與諸眷屬持眾香華及諸妓樂至如來所，白言：「時至，願垂降臨。
english: By the next morning, he, together with his relatives and attendants, took various fragrances, flowers, and musical performers to where the Tathagata was, and said: "The time has come; we hope you will graciously descend and arrive."

chinese: 」爾時世尊軟語安慰彼婆羅門無垢妙光，遍告大眾，宣言：「汝等皆應往彼婆羅門家攝受供養，為欲令彼獲大利故。
english: At that time the World-Honored One spoke gently to comfort that Brahmin Immaculate Wonderful Light, and declared to the great assembly everywhere: "All of you should go to that Brahmin's home and accept his offerings, for the sake of enabling him to attain great benefit.

chinese: 」於時世尊即從座起，纔起座已從佛身出種種光明，間錯妙色照觸十方，悉皆警覺，然後趣道。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One immediately rose from his seat. As soon as he had risen, various lights of wonderful colors emanated from the Buddha's body, interlacing and illuminating the ten directions. All [beings] were thereby awakened, and thereafter they proceeded along the Way.

chinese: 時婆羅門以恭敬心持妙香華，與諸眷屬及天龍八部、釋梵四王，先行治道，奉引如來。
english: At that time the Brahman, with a respectful heart, held wonderful incense and flowers, and together with his various retinue, the heavenly beings, dragons, the eight classes of beings, Indra, Brahma, and the Four Heavenly Kings, went ahead to prepare the road and respectfully escort the Tathagata.

chinese: 爾時世尊前路不遠，中至一園名曰豐財。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One had not traveled far on the road when he arrived at a garden named Abundant Wealth.

chinese: 於彼園中有古朽塔，摧壞崩倒荊棘掩庭、蔓草封戶瓦礫埋隱，狀若土堆。
english: In that garden there was an ancient, decayed pagoda, crumbled and collapsed, with thorns obscuring the courtyard and vines sealing the doors, while tiles and rubble lay buried and concealed, appearing like a mound of earth.

chinese: 爾時世尊逕往塔所。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One went directly to the stupa.

chinese: 于時塔上放大光明照耀熾盛，於土聚中出聲讚言：「善哉善哉！
english: At that time, great light radiated brilliantly from the stupa, and a voice emerged from the earth, proclaiming: "Excellent! Excellent!

chinese: 釋迦牟尼！
english: Shakyamuni!

chinese: 今日所行極善境界。
english: Today we have traveled through an extremely good/virtuous realm.

chinese: 又婆羅門！
english: "Moreover, Brahmin!"

chinese: 汝於今日獲大善利。
english: You have obtained great merit and benefit today.

chinese: 」爾時世尊禮彼朽塔，右繞三迊，脫身上衣用覆其上，泫然垂淚涕血交流，泣已微笑。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One bowed to that decayed stupa, circumambulated it three times to the right, removed his upper garment and covered it over the stupa, tears flowing and blood-tinged tears streaming forth together, and after weeping he smiled faintly.

chinese: 當爾之時，十方諸佛皆同觀視亦皆流淚，各所放光來照是塔。
english: At that time, all the Buddhas of the ten directions together observed and gazed upon it, and all equally shed tears. Each one emitted light that came to illuminate this stupa.

chinese: 于時大眾驚愕變色，互欲決疑。
english: At that time the great assembly was startled and alarmed, changing color, and mutually wished to resolve their doubts.

chinese: 爾時金剛手菩薩等亦皆流淚，威焰熾盛執杵旋轉，往詣佛所，白言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the Bodhisattva Vajrapani and others also all shed tears. With fierce and blazing auras, wielding their vajras and rotating them, they went before the Buddha and spoke, saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 此何因緣現是光相？
english: What is the cause and condition for this light appearance to manifest?

chinese: 何如來眼流淚如是？
english: "Why does the Tathagata's eye flow with tears like this?"

chinese: 亦彼十方諸佛大瑞光相現前？
english: "Is it also that the great auspicious light-marks of the Buddhas of the ten directions manifest before [us]?"

chinese: 唯願如來於此大眾解釋我疑。
english: I only wish that the Tathagata would resolve my doubt before this great assembly.

chinese: 」時薄伽梵告金剛手：「此大全身舍利積聚如來寶塔，一切如來無量俱胝心陀羅尼密印法要今在其中。
english: At that time, the Bhagavat told Vajrapani: "This great complete body of relics accumulated as a Thus-come-one's precious stupa contains all the Thus-come-ones' immeasurable kotis of heart dharanis and secret seal teachings."

chinese: 金剛手！
english: Vajrapani!

chinese: 有此法要在是中故，塔即變為重疊無隙如胡麻子俱胝百千如來之身。
english: Because this dharma-method exists within it, the stupa immediately transforms into layered forms without gaps, like sesame seeds, containing the bodies of countless buddhas numbering in the hundreds of thousands, like Avalokiteshvara's multitude.

chinese: 當知亦是如胡麻子百千俱胝如來全身舍利之聚，乃至八萬四千法蘊亦在其中，九十九百千萬俱胝如來頂相亦在其中。
english: Know that this is also a gathering of the complete body relics of hundreds of thousands of kotis of Tathagatas, like sesame seeds. Moreover, the eighty-four thousand dharma-treasures are also contained within it, and the head-marks of ninety-nine hundred thousand kotis of Tathagatas are also contained within it.

chinese: 由是妙事，是塔所在之處，有大神驗殊勝威德，能滿一切世間吉慶。
english: By this marvelous matter, wherever this stupa is located, there are great divine manifestations and extraordinary excellent virtues, capable of fulfilling all auspiciousness and blessings in the world.

chinese: 」爾時大眾聞佛是說，遠塵離垢斷諸煩惱，得法眼淨。
english: At that time, the great assembly, having heard the Buddha's teaching, freed themselves from dust and defilement, severed all afflictions, and attained the purity of the Dharma eye.

chinese: 時眾機異利益亦別，須陀洹果、斯陀含果、阿那含果、阿羅漢果、辟支佛道，及菩薩道、阿鞞跋致、薩波若智，於如是事各得其一，或有證得初地二地乃至十地，或有滿足六波羅蜜。
english: At that time, the faculties of the assembly were different and their benefits also varied. Some attained the fruit of stream-entry, some the fruit of once-returner, some the fruit of non-returner, some the fruit of arhat, some the path of the pratyekabuddha, and some the path of the bodhisattva. Some attained irreversibility, some attained the knowledge of all aspects. In such matters, each obtained one according to their capacity. Some realized the first ground, the second ground, up to the tenth ground. Some perfected the six perfections.
