chinese: 其婆羅門遠塵離垢，得五神通。
english: That Brahmin, far removed from dust and defilement, attained the five divine powers.

chinese: 時金剛手見此奇特希有之事，白言：「世尊！
english: At that time, Vajrapani, seeing this rare and extraordinary event, spoke to the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 妙哉奇異。
english: Wonderful and strange indeed!

chinese: 但聞此事尚獲如是殊勝功德，況聞深理至心起信得幾功德？
english: "If merely hearing of this matter already obtains such exceptional merit, how much more so when one hears the profound principles and generates sincere faith—what merit is gained!"

chinese: 」佛言：「諦聽。
english: The Buddha said: "Listen carefully.

chinese: 汝金剛手！
english: "You, Vajrapani!"

chinese: 後世若有信男信女及復我等四部弟子，發心書寫此一經典，即准書寫九十九百千萬俱胝如來所說一切經典，即過於彼九十九百千萬俱胝如來之前久植善根，即亦彼諸一切如來加持護念猶如愛眼，亦如慈母愛護幼子。
english: In future generations, if there are faithful men and faithful women, as well as our four categories of disciples who generate the aspiration to copy out this one scripture, they shall be regarded as having copied out all the scriptures spoken by ninety-nine hundred thousand myriads of koṭis of Tathāgatas. Moreover, they shall surpass those who planted wholesome roots long ago before ninety-nine hundred thousand myriads of koṭis of Tathāgatas. All those Tathāgatas shall bestow empowerment and protection with mindfulness toward them, just as they protect their own eyes, and just as a compassionate mother protects her young child.

chinese: 若人讀誦此一卷經，即為讀誦過去現在未來諸佛所說經典。
english: If a person reads and recites this one volume of scripture, he immediately reads and recites the scriptures expounded by all the Buddhas of the past, present, and future.

chinese: 由如是故，九十九百千萬俱胝一切如來應正等覺側塞無隙猶如胡麻重疊赴來，晝夜現身加持其人。
english: Because of this, ninety-nine hundred thousand myriads of kotis of all Tathagatas, Arhat-Samyaksambuddhas, crowding together without gaps like sesame seeds, layer upon layer, come rushing forth and manifest their bodies day and night to empower that person.

chinese: 如是一切諸佛如來無數恒沙，前聚未去後群重來，須臾推遷迴轉更赴，譬如細沙在水旋急，不得停滯迴去復來。
english: Thus all the Buddhas and Tathāgatas, countless as the sands of the Ganges, in the front assembly have not departed while the rear multitude arrives again. Moment by moment they are displaced and transformed, hastening forward once more. It is like fine sand in water swirling rapidly, unable to remain still, turning back and coming again.

chinese: 若有人以香華塗香、華鬘衣服、微妙嚴具供養此經，即成於彼十方九十九百千萬俱胝如來之前，以天香華、衣服嚴具七寶所成積如須彌盡以供養，種植善根亦復如是。
english: If there is someone who makes offerings to this Sutra with incense, flowers, fragrant unguents, garlands, clothing, and exquisite ornaments, then before the Tathagatas of ninety-nine hundred thousand myriad kotis in the ten directions, they will have made offerings accumulated like Mount Sumeru, consisting of heavenly fragrant flowers, clothing, ornamental objects, and the seven treasures. In the same way, they plant roots of goodness.

chinese: 」爾時天龍八部人非人等聞是說已，各懷希奇，互相謂言：「奇哉威德！
english: At that time, the heavenly beings, dragons, and the eight classes of non-human creatures, upon hearing this teaching, each harbored wonder and astonishment. They spoke to one another, saying: "How extraordinary is this majestic virtue!

chinese: 是朽土聚如來神力所加持故，有是神變。
english: It is because this decayed earth, gathered together, is sustained by the spiritual power of the Tathagata that such miraculous transformation occurs.

chinese: 」金剛手復白佛言：「世尊！
english: Vajrapani spoke again to the Buddha saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 何因緣故，是七寶塔現為土聚？
english: For what reason and cause does this seven-jeweled pagoda manifest as a heap of earth?

chinese: 」佛告金剛手：「此非土聚，乃是殊妙大寶塔耳。
english: The Buddha told Vajrapani: "This is not a heap of earth, but rather a supremely wonderful great precious stupa."

chinese: 由諸眾生業果劣故隱蔽不現。
english: Due to the inferior karma and fruits of various sentient beings, it is obscured and does not manifest.

chinese: 由塔隱故，如來全身非可毀壞，豈有如來金剛藏身而可壞哉？
english: Because the stupa is hidden, the Tathagata's entire body cannot be destroyed. How could the Tathagata's vajra-treasury body be subject to destruction?

chinese: 我若滅度，後世末法逼迫之時，若有眾生習行非法應墮地獄，不信三寶不植善根，為是因緣佛法當隱，然猶是塔堅固不滅，一切如來神力所持。
english: If I were to enter Nirvana, in the later age of the Dharma's decline when persecution prevails, if there were sentient beings who practice unlawful conduct and should fall into hell, who do not believe in the Three Jewels and do not plant wholesome roots, for this reason the Buddha-dharma would become hidden. Yet the stupas would still remain firm and indestructible, upheld by the miraculous power of all the Tathagatas.

chinese: 無智眾生惑障覆蔽，徒朽珍寶不知採用，以是事故我今流淚，彼諸如來亦皆流淚。
english: Ignorant sentient beings are covered and obscured by delusion and obstruction, squandering precious jewels without knowing how to use them. For this reason I now shed tears, and those Tathagatas also all shed tears.

chinese: 」復次佛告金剛手言：「若有眾生書寫此經置塔中者，是塔即為一切如來金剛藏窣都婆，亦為一切如來陀羅尼心祕密加持窣都婆，即為九十九百千萬俱胝如來窣都婆，亦為一切如來佛頂佛眼窣都婆，即為一切如來神力所護。
english:
# Translation

"Furthermore, the Buddha told Vajrapani: 'If there are sentient beings who write out this scripture and place it in a stupa, that stupa becomes the stupa of the vajra treasury of all Tathagatas, and also becomes the stupa of the secret mantra heart and esoteric empowerment of all Tathagatas. It becomes the stupa of ninety-nine hundred thousand myriad kotis of Tathagatas, and also becomes the stupa of the Buddha-crown and Buddha-eye of all Tathagatas. It thus becomes protected by the supernatural power of all Tathagatas.'"

chinese: 若佛像中、窣都婆中安置此經，其像即為七寶所成，靈驗應心，無願不滿；其窣都婆，傘蓋羅網輪橖露盤、德鈴鐸、楹礎基階隨力所，或土或木若石若甎，由經威力自為七寶。
english: If this scripture is placed within a Buddhist image or within a stupa, that image will immediately be composed of the seven treasures, and its spiritual efficacy will respond to wishes, with no vow left unfulfilled. As for the stupa, its umbrella, canopy, net, wheels, pillars, dew pans, virtue bells and chimes, pillars, bases, foundations, and steps—whether made of earth, wood, stone, or brick according to one's capacity—through the power of the scripture will naturally become the seven treasures.

chinese: 一切如來於此經典加其威力，以誠實言不斷加持。
english: All Tathagatas empower this scripture with their spiritual force, continuously sustaining it through words of truth.

chinese: 若有有情能於此塔一香一華禮拜供養，八十億劫生死重罪一時消滅，生免災殃、死生佛家。
english: If any sentient being makes offerings to this stupa with even a single stick of incense or a single flower in respectful worship, the heavy karmic sins of eighty billion kalpas of birth and death shall be instantly extinguished. In life, they shall be free from calamities and misfortunes; at death, they shall be born in the Buddha's household.

chinese: 若有應墮阿鼻地獄，若於此塔或一禮拜、或一右遶，塞地獄門、開菩提路。
english: If there is one who should fall into the Avici Hell, yet if they make but one prostration or circumambulation to this stupa, the gates of hell will be sealed and the path to bodhi will be opened.

chinese: 塔及形像所在之處，一切如來神力所護，其處不為暴風雷電霹靂所害，不為毒蛇蚖蝮毒蟲毒獸所傷，不為師子狂象、虎狼野干、蜂蠆之所傷害，亦無藥叉、羅剎、部多、那毘舍，遮魑魅魍魎癲癎之怖，亦復不為一切寒熱諸病、癧瘻癰疽、瘡疣疥癩所染。
english: Wherever the pagoda and images are located, all Tathagatas protect with their supernatural power. Such places are not harmed by violent winds, thunder, lightning, and thunderbolts; not injured by poisonous snakes, vipers, centipedes, venomous insects, and poisonous beasts; not harmed by lions, mad elephants, tigers, wolves, wild jackals, and bees and wasps; and are also free from the terrors of yakshas, rakshasas, pisachas, and pretas. They are protected from the deceptions of demons and ghosts, and are not afflicted by epilepsy. Furthermore, they are not infected by all manner of cold and heat diseases, ringworm, fistulas, abscesses, festering sores, warts, scabies, and leprosy.

chinese: 若人暫見是塔，能除一切災難。
english: If a person merely sees this pagoda, they can eliminate all calamities and hardships.

chinese: 其處亦無人馬六畜、童子童女疫癘之患。
english: In that place there are also no afflictions of plague among people, horses, livestock, boys, and girls.

chinese: 不為橫死非命所夭。
english: "Not meeting with sudden death or untimely demise."

chinese: 不為刀杖水火所傷、不為盜賊怨讎所侵、亦無飢饉貧乏之憂、厭魅呪咀不能得便。
english: Not harmed by swords, staves, water, or fire; not invaded by thieves, bandits, enemies, or adversaries; free from worries of famine, poverty, or destitution; and untouched by the influence of demons, curses, or hexes.

chinese: 四大天王與諸眷屬晝夜衛護、二十八部大藥叉將、日月五星、幢雲彗星晝夜護持，一切龍王加其精氣順時降雨，一切諸天與忉利天三時下來亦為供養，一切諸仙三時來集讚詠旋遶禮謝瞻仰，釋提桓因與諸天女晝夜三時來下供養，其處即為一切如來護念加持。
english: The Four Heavenly Kings and their retinues guard and protect day and night; the twenty-eight great yaksha generals, the sun, moon, five planets, banners, clouds, and comets maintain protection day and night. All dragon kings add their vital essence and cause rain to fall in due season. All the devas and the devas of Trayastrimsha descend three times daily to make offerings. All the immortals gather three times daily to praise, circumambulate, pay respects, and gaze upward. Shakra and the celestial maidens descend three times daily and night to make offerings. That place is thereby protected and upheld in mind by all the Tathagatas.

chinese: 由納經故，塔即如是。
english: Because of the sūtras being collected, the pagoda is thus as it is.

chinese: 若人作塔以土石木金銀銅鉛，書此神呪安置其中，纔安置已其塔即為七寶所成，上下階級、露盤傘蓋、鈴鐸輪樘純為七寶，其塔四方如來形相，由法要故，一切如來堅住護持晝夜不去。
english: If a person builds a stupa from earth, stone, wood, gold, silver, copper, or lead, and writes this divine mantra and places it within, as soon as it is placed, that stupa becomes made of the seven treasures. Its ascending and descending levels, the exposed base, parasol canopy, bells, and finials are all purely of the seven treasures. The four sides of that stupa have the forms of the Tathagatas, and because of the power of the dharma, all the Tathagatas firmly dwell and protect it, never departing day and night.

chinese: 其七寶塔全身舍利之妙寶藏，以呪威力，擢竦高至阿迦尼吒天宮之中，塔所串峙，一切諸天晝夜瞻仰守衛供養。
english: The entire wonderful treasure store of relics within the seven-jeweled pagoda, through the power of mantras, was lifted and raised high to the palace of Akanistha heaven. The pagoda stood piercing the sky, and all the devas constantly gazed upon it, protected it, and made offerings to it day and night.

chinese: 」金剛手言：「何因緣故，此法如是殊勝功德？
english: Vajrapani said: "What is the reason and cause that this dharma possesses such supreme merit and virtue?"

chinese: 」佛言：「當知以此寶篋印陀羅尼威神力故。
english: The Buddha said: "You should know that it is by virtue of the awesome spiritual power of this Precious Casket Dharani.

chinese: 」金剛手言：「唯願如來哀愍我等，說是陀羅尼。
english: Vajrapani said: "We only wish that the Tathagata would compassionately take pity on us and expound this dharani."

chinese: 」佛言：「諦聽，思念莫忘。
english: The Buddha said: "Listen attentively, and do not forget to contemplate.

chinese: 現在未來一切如來分身光儀、過去諸佛全身舍利，皆在寶篋印陀羅尼，是諸如來所有三身亦在是中。
english: Now all the Tathāgata manifestation bodies and light forms of the present and future, and all the complete reliquaries of the Buddhas of the past, are all contained within the Dharani of the Precious Casket Seal. The three bodies of all these Tathāgatas are also within this.

chinese: 」爾時世尊即說陀羅尼曰：「那莫悉怛哩野地尾迦南薩婆怛他蘖多喃唵部尾婆嚩娜嚩唎嚩者梨嚩者祖嚕祖嚕馱囉馱囉薩嚩怛他蘖多馱覩馱梨鉢娜婆嚩底惹也嚩梨畝怛梨薩磨囉怛他蘖多達磨斫迦囉鉢羅靺栗多娜嚩羅地滿拏楞迦囉楞訖哩諦薩嚩怛他多地瑟恥諦馱野馱野地地沒沒參馱儞參馱野者攞者攞者懶都薩嚩嚩囉拏儞薩嚩播波尾諦戶嚕戶嚕薩嚩戍迦弭帝薩嚩怛他多哩娜野嚩日囉抳三婆囉三婆囉薩嚩怛他多虞野馱囉抳畝涅梨沒悌蘇沒悌薩嚩怛他多地瑟恥多馱覩陛娑嚩賀三摩耶地瑟恥帝娑嚩訶薩嚩怛他多哩娜野馱覩畝捺犁娑嚩訶蘇鉢羅底瑟恥多薩覩閉怛他多地瑟恥帝戶嚕戶嚕吽吽娑嚩訶唵薩嚩怛他多塢瑟抳沙馱覩畝捺囉尼薩嚩怛他單娑馱覩尾部使多地瑟恥帝吽吽娑嚩訶」爾時佛說是神呪已，諸佛如來自土聚中出聲讚言：「善哉善哉！
english:
At that time, the World-Honored One spoke the dhāraṇī, saying: "Namo sitāriyadī-vikānana, sarva-tathāgatānām. Om buvi-vānavāri-vāzarī-vāzazuru-zuru-dhāra-dhāra, sarva-tathāgata-dātu-dārī-patnabhāvavādi-rayā-vārimutarī-samara-tathāgata-dharma-zakkara-pāramlita-nāvāra-dī-mānna-lengkāra-lengkirti-sarva-tathā-di-seizti-dhāya-dhāya-dī-dī-momo-samdānī-samdāya-zarā-zarā-zarani-du-sarva-vāra-nī-sarva-pāpa-vīti-huru-huru-sarva-sukāmīti-sarva-tathā-darīnāya-vārā-nī-sambara-sambara-sarva-tathā-yūya-dhāra-nī-munirolī-momti-suomti-sarva-tathā-di-seizta-dātu-bai-sāvāhā-samāya-di-seizti-sāvāhā-sarva-tathā-darīnāya-dātu-munatarī-sāvāhā-subara-di-seizta-sātu-bi-dathā-di-seizti-du-huru-huru-hum-hum-sāvāhā-om-sarva-tathā-uzanī-sādhātu-munatarāni-sarva-tathā-sādhātu-vibuiti-di-seizti-du-hum-hum-sāvāhā."

When the Buddha had spoken this sacred incantation, the Tathāgatas, the Buddhas, emerged from the earth and uttered praise, saying: "Excellent! Excellent!

chinese: 釋迦世尊出濁惡世，為利無依無怙眾生演說深法。
english: The World-Honored One Shakyamuni appeared in this defiled and evil world and expounded the profound Dharma for the benefit of all sentient beings who lack support and protection.

chinese: 如是法要久住世間，利益廣多安穩快樂。
english: Thus this dharma should long abide in the world, bringing extensive benefit, peace, and happiness.

chinese: 」于時佛告金剛手言：「諦聽諦聽。
english: At that time the Buddha said to Vajrapani: "Listen carefully, listen carefully.

chinese: 如是法要神力無窮利益無邊，譬如幢上如意寶珠，常雨珍寶滿一切願。
english: This dharma, being of such essential importance, possesses boundless divine power and unlimited benefit. It is like the wish-fulfilling jewel atop a banner, which constantly rains forth precious treasures and fulfills all wishes.

chinese: 我今略說萬分之一，汝宜憶持利益一切。
english: I shall now briefly explain one ten-thousandth of it; you should remember and uphold it for the benefit of all.

chinese: 若有惡人死墮地獄，受苦無間免脫無期。
english: If an evil person dies and falls into hell, they suffer torment without respite, with no period of liberation in sight.

chinese: 有其子孫稱亡者名，誦上神呪纔至七遍，洋銅熱鐵忽然變為八功德池，蓮生承足寶蓋駐頂，地獄門破菩提道開，其蓮如飛至極樂界，一切種智自然顯發，樂說無窮位在補處。
english: There was a descendant who called upon the name of the deceased. After reciting the supreme divine mantra merely seven times, the molten copper and hot iron suddenly transformed into the Eight Pools of Merit and Virtue. Lotuses arose to support the feet, and precious canopies rested upon the crown. The gates of hell broke open and the Bodhi path opened wide. The lotus flew to the Land of Ultimate Bliss, wherein all-encompassing wisdom naturally manifested, and with inexhaustible eloquence, he was established in the position of Bodhisattva-heir.

chinese: 復有眾生重罪報故，百病集身苦痛逼心，誦此神呪二十一遍，百病萬惱一時消滅，壽命延長福德無盡。
english: Furthermore, there are sentient beings whose heavy karmic retributions cause a hundred illnesses to gather in their bodies and suffering to press upon their minds. If they recite this divine mantra twenty-one times, all hundred illnesses and ten thousand afflictions will be eliminated at once, their lifespan will be extended, and their merit and virtue will be boundless.

chinese: 若復有人慳貪業故生貧窮家，衣不隱身食不續命，瘦衰蔽人所惡賤。
english: If there be those who, due to the karma of stinginess and greed, are born into poor families where clothing does not cover the body and food does not sustain life, becoming emaciated and despised by others.

chinese: 是人慚愧入山折採無主搹華，若磨朽木持以號香，往至塔前禮拜供養，旋遶七匝流淚悔過，由神呪力及塔威德，滅貧窮報富貴忽至，七寶如雨無所闕乏。
english: This person, feeling ashamed, entered the mountains and gathered ownerless flowers. If one grinds decayed wood and holds it as incense, goes before the pagoda, makes prostrations and offerings, circumambulates seven times with flowing tears in repentance, through the power of divine spells and the spiritual virtue of the pagoda, the karmic retribution of poverty is extinguished and sudden wealth arrives. The seven treasures fall like rain with nothing lacking or insufficient.

chinese: 但當此時，彌飾佛法施與貧乏，若有悋惜財寶忽滅。
english: But at this time, if one conceals and does not practice the Buddha's teaching of giving to the poor and destitute, if one possesses stinginess toward treasures, they will suddenly perish.

chinese: 若復有人為種善根隨分造塔，或泥或甎隨力所，大如菴羅高四指許，書寫神呪安置其中，持以香華禮拜供養。
english: If there are people who plant wholesome roots by constructing pagodas according to their capacity, whether made of clay or brick according to their strength, as large as a mango fruit or four finger-widths high, inscribe divine mantras within and place them there, and carry them while venerating and making offerings with incense and flowers.

chinese: 以其呪力及信心故，自小塔中出大香雲，香氣雲光周遍法界，薰馥晃曜廣作佛事，所得功德如上所說，取要言之無願不滿。
english: By virtue of his magical power and faith, from the small pagoda emerged great clouds of fragrance, and the fragrance, clouds, and light pervaded throughout the dharma realm, permeating and illuminating widely, performing Buddha's work extensively. The merit obtained was as described above—in brief, there was no aspiration that was not fulfilled.

chinese: 若薄福不信者，亦心生信解，亦得同超佛境，真實不虛。
english: If those with meager blessings and lack of faith also generate faith and understanding in their hearts, they will likewise transcend together to the Buddha's realm, truly and not falsely.

chinese: 夫觀世音誓願弘深，發大悲心，以濟度群生。
english: "Now, observe that Avalokitesvara's vows are profoundly expansive, having aroused a great compassionate heart to save and deliver all sentient beings."

chinese: 朕君臨天下，閔眾情之昏瞀，墮五濁而不知，以此經呪，用是方便，覺悟提撕，俾一切庶類，皆超佛域。
english: I, the Emperor, reign over all under Heaven. Observing that the masses are confused and benighted, falling into the five corruptions without awareness, I use this sutra and spell as expedient means to awaken and uplift them, causing all sentient beings to transcend into the Buddha realm.

chinese: 又況如來化導，首重忠孝。
english: Furthermore, the Tathagata's transformation and guidance places foremost importance on loyalty and filial piety.

chinese: 凡忠臣孝子，能盡心以事君，竭力以事親，所作所為，無私智陂行，廣積陰功，濟人利物，又能持誦是經呪，則跬步之間，即見如來。
english: All loyal ministers and filial sons who can devote their hearts to serving their rulers and exhaust their strength in serving their parents, whose actions and conduct harbor no selfish schemes or improper behavior, who widely accumulate hidden merit, benefit people and aid things, and who are furthermore able to recite and uphold this sutra and dharani—within every few steps they take, they shall immediately perceive the Tathagata.

chinese: 若彼不忠不孝，不知敬畏，則鬼神所錄，陰加譴罰，轉眄之間，即成地獄。
english: If he is disloyal and unfilial, knows not reverence and awe, then the spirits and gods will record it, and secretly inflict punishment upon him. In the turning of an eye, he shall become hell itself.

chinese: 蓋善惡兩途，由人所趨，凡我眾庶，宜慎取舍，書此以為勸！
english: Since good and evil are two paths determined by human choice, all of you commoners should be careful in your selections and decisions. I write this as an exhortation!

chinese: 永樂九年六月日如是我聞：一時，釋迦牟尼佛在補陀落迦山，觀世音宮殿，寶莊嚴道場中，坐寶師子座。
english: In the ninth year of Yongle, in the sixth month, on such a day, thus I heard: At one time, Shakyamuni Buddha was in the palace of Avalokiteshvara on Mount Potala, in the treasure-adorned bodhimanda, seated upon a precious lion throne.

chinese: 其座純以無量雜摩尼寶，而用莊嚴，百寶幢旛，周匝懸列。
english: Its seat is purely adorned with immeasurable varied maṇi jewels, with hundreds of jeweled banners and streamers suspended all around it in a circle.

chinese: 爾時，如來於彼座上，將欲演說總持陀羅尼故。
english: At that time, the Tathagata, seated upon that throne, was about to expound the dharani of total retention.

chinese: 與無央數菩薩摩訶薩俱，其名曰：總持王菩薩、寶王菩薩、藥王菩薩、藥上菩薩、觀世音菩薩、大勢至菩薩、華嚴菩薩、大莊嚴菩薩、寶藏菩薩、德藏菩薩、金剛藏菩薩、虛空藏菩薩、彌勒菩薩、普賢菩薩、文殊師利菩薩，如是等菩薩摩訶薩，皆是灌頂大法王子。
english: Together with innumerable great bodhisattvas, whose names are as follows: Bodhisattva Dharani King, Bodhisattva Jewel King, Bodhisattva Medicine King, Bodhisattva Medicine Superior, Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, Bodhisattva Mahasthamaprapta, Bodhisattva Flower Adornment, Bodhisattva Great Adornment, Bodhisattva Treasure Store, Bodhisattva Virtue Store, Bodhisattva Vajra Store, Bodhisattva Space Store, Bodhisattva Maitreya, Bodhisattva Samantabhadra, and Bodhisattva Manjushri. Such great bodhisattvas as these are all crowned great dharma princes.

chinese: 又與無量無數大聲聞僧，皆行阿羅漢十地，摩訶迦葉而為上首。
english: Again, with immeasurable and countless great assemblies of voice-hearers, all practicing the ten stages of the arhat, with Mahakasyapa as the foremost.

chinese: 又與無量梵摩羅天，善吒梵摩而為上首。
english: And together with immeasurable Brahma-Maralodeva, with Shantabrahma as the chief.

chinese: 又與無量欲界諸天子俱，瞿婆伽天子而為上首。
english: "And together with countless heavenly sons of the desire realm, with the heavenly son Kubhaka as the foremost."

chinese: 又與無量護世四王俱，提頭賴吒而為上首。
english: And together with the immeasurable Four Heavenly Kings who protect the world, with Dhritarashtra as the foremost.

chinese: 又與無量天、龍、夜叉、乾闥婆、阿修羅、迦樓羅、緊那羅、摩睺羅伽、人、非人等俱，天德大龍王而為上首。
english: And together with countless gods, dragons, yakshas, gandharvas, asuras, garudas, kinnaras, mahoragas, humans, non-humans and others, with the great dragon king Tianде as the foremost among them.

chinese: 又與無量欲界諸天女俱，童目天女而為上首。
english: "And together with immeasurable heavenly maidens of the desire realm, with the Maiden of Pure Eyes as the foremost."

chinese: 又與無量虛空神、江海神、泉源神、河沼神、藥草神、樹林神、舍宅神、水神、火神、地神、風神、土神、山神、石神、宮殿等神，皆來集會。
english: And together with countless spirits of empty space, spirits of rivers and seas, spirits of springs and sources, spirits of marshes and wetlands, spirits of medicinal herbs, spirits of forests and groves, spirits of dwellings and houses, spirits of water, spirits of fire, spirits of earth, spirits of wind, spirits of soil, spirits of mountains, spirits of stones, and spirits of palaces and similar deities, all gathered together.

chinese: 時觀世音菩薩，於大會中密放神通，光明照曜，十方剎土及此三千大千世界，皆作金色。
english: At that time, the Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, within the great assembly, secretly manifested supernatural powers. His radiant light illuminated the Buddha-lands of the ten directions and this three-thousand-fold great thousand world, causing them all to appear in golden color.

chinese: 天宮、龍宮、諸尊神宮，皆悉震動；江河、大海、鐵圍山、須彌山、土山、黑山，亦皆大動。
english: The heavenly palaces, dragon palaces, and palaces of all the honored deities all trembled and shook; the rivers, great seas, iron-encircling mountains, Mount Sumeru, earth mountains, and black mountains also all greatly moved.

chinese: 日、月、珠、火、星宿之光，皆悉不現。
english: The light of the sun, moon, pearls, fire, and stars all completely disappears.

chinese: 於是總持王菩薩，見此希有之相，怪曾有。
english: Then the Bodhisattva, the King of Total Retention, seeing these rare and unprecedented signs, was greatly astonished.

chinese: 即從座起，叉手合掌，以偈問佛，如此神通之相，是誰所放？
english: He immediately rose from his seat, placed his palms together with interlaced fingers, and asked the Buddha in verse: "Whose spiritual powers and supernatural manifestations are these?"

chinese: 以偈問曰：「誰於今日成正覺？
english: "Who has attained perfect enlightenment today?"

chinese: 普放如是大光明，十方剎土皆金色，三千世界亦復然。
english: He universally emitted such great luminous light that the ten directions of lands all became golden in color, and the three thousand worlds were likewise so.

chinese: 誰於今日得自在？
english: Who among those today attains freedom?

chinese: 演放希有大神力，無邊佛國皆震動，龍神宮殿悉不安。
english: The perfect manifestation [of the dharma] possesses great divine power; all the boundless Buddha-lands trembled, and the palaces of dragons and deities were all shaken with unease.

chinese: 今此大眾咸有疑，不測因緣是誰力？
english: Now in this great assembly all have doubt: what power is it that brings about such unfathomable causes and conditions?

chinese: 為佛菩薩大聲聞？
english: "Is it for the Buddha, bodhisattvas, and great arhats?"

chinese: 為梵魔天諸釋等？
english:
"Are they Brahma, Maras, devas, Śākyans, and others?"

or

"Why are [they] Brahma, Maras, deities, Śākyans, and so forth?"

chinese: 唯願世尊大慈悲，說此神通所由以！
english: I only wish the World-Honored One, with great compassion, would explain the reason and origin of this miraculous power!

chinese: 」佛告總持王菩薩言：「善男子！
english: The Buddha told the Bodhisattva Dharani King: "Good son!

chinese: 汝等當知，今此會中，有一菩薩摩訶薩，名曰『觀世音自在』。
english: You should know that in this assembly there is a bodhisattva mahasattva named "Avalokiteshvara the Freely Acting."

chinese: 從無量劫來，成就大慈大悲，善能修習無量陀羅尼門，為欲安樂諸眾生故，密放如是大神通力。
english: From countless kalpas past, having perfected great compassion and great mercy, skillfully cultivating the gateways of immeasurable dharanis, in order to bring peace and bliss to all sentient beings, he secretly manifests such great supernatural powers.

chinese: 」佛說是語已。
english: "When the Buddha had spoken these words."

chinese: 爾時，觀世音菩薩，從座而起，整理衣服，向佛合掌，白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara rose from his seat, arranged his robes, joined his palms together facing the Buddha, and spoke to the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 我有大悲心陀羅尼呪，今當欲說。
english: I have the great compassion dharani mantra, which I shall now expound.

chinese: 為諸眾生得安樂故，除一切病故，得壽命故，得富饒故，滅除一切惡業、重罪故，離障難故，增長一切白法諸功德故，成就一切諸善根故，遠離一切諸怖畏故，速能滿足一切諸希求故。
english: For the sake of all sentient beings obtaining peace and happiness, for the elimination of all diseases, for the attainment of longevity, for the attainment of wealth and abundance, for the extinction of all evil karma and grave sins, for liberation from obstacles and difficulties, for the increase and growth of all wholesome dharmas and virtuous merits, for the accomplishment of all wholesome roots, for the distance from all fears and terrors, for the swift fulfillment of all hopes and aspirations.

chinese: 惟願世尊，慈哀聽許！
english: "I only wish that the World-Honored One will compassionately hear and grant permission!"

chinese: 」佛言：「善男子！
english: "The Buddha said: 'Good man!

chinese: 汝大慈悲，安樂眾生。
english: "You possess great compassion and benevolence, bringing peace and happiness to all sentient beings."

chinese: 欲說神呪，今正是時，宜應速說。
english: "The time is now right to speak of the divine incantation; it is fitting that you speak it forthwith."

chinese: 如來隨喜，諸佛亦然。
english: The Tathagata rejoices, and all the Buddhas do likewise.

chinese: 」觀世音菩薩重白佛言：「世尊！
english: "Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva again respectfully addressed the Buddha, saying: 'World Honored One!'"

chinese: 我念過去無量億劫，有佛出世，名曰『千光王靜住如來』。
english: I recall that in the immeasurable and infinite kalpas of the past, there was a Buddha who appeared in the world, named 'Thousand Light King Silent Dwelling Tathagata.'

chinese: 彼佛世尊憐念我故，及為一切諸眾生故，說此『廣大圓滿無礙大悲心陀羅尼』。
english: The Buddha, the World-Honored One, out of compassion for me and for the sake of all sentient beings, expounded this "Great Compassionate Heart Dharani of Vast, Complete, and Unobstructed Great Compassion."

chinese: 以金色手摩我頂上作如是言：『善男子！
english: With a golden hand he touched the top of my head and spoke thus: "Good son!

chinese: 汝當持此心呪，普為未來惡世一切眾生，作大利樂。
english: You should hold fast to this heart-mantra and universally, for all sentient beings in the evil worlds of the future, create great benefit and happiness.

chinese: 』「我於是時，始住初地，一聞此呪故，超第八地。
english: "At that time, I first dwelt on the First Ground, but upon hearing this mantra once, I transcended to the Eighth Ground.

chinese: 我時心歡喜故，即發誓言：『若我當來，堪能利益、安樂一切眾生者，令我即時，身生千手、千眼具足。
english: When my mind was delighted at that time, I immediately made this vow: 'If, in my future coming, I am able to benefit and bring peace and happiness to all sentient beings, may I then and there have a thousand hands and a thousand eyes fully manifested upon my body.'

chinese: 』「發是願已，應時身上，千手千眼，悉皆具足；十方大地，六種震動；十方千佛，悉放光明，照觸我身，及照十方，無邊世界。
english: "When this vow was made, at that very moment my body manifested a thousand hands and a thousand eyes, all completely perfect. The great earth in all ten directions trembled in six ways. The thousand buddhas of the ten directions all emitted light, illuminating my body and extending to all ten directions, lighting up all the boundless worlds.

chinese: 「從是已後，復於無量佛所、無量會中，重更得聞，親承受持，是陀羅尼。
english: "From this time onward, in the presence of countless Buddhas and in countless assemblies, they repeatedly heard again and personally received and upheld this dharani.

chinese: 復生歡喜，踊躍無量，便得超越無數億劫微細生死。
english: Revived with joy, they leap and dance with boundless exultation, and thereby immediately attain transcendence over countless hundreds of millions of kalpas of subtle births and deaths.

chinese: 從是已來，常所誦持，未曾廢忘，由持此呪故，所生之處，恒在佛前，蓮華化生，不受胎藏之身。
english: Since then, I have constantly recited and upheld it without ever abandoning or forgetting it. By virtue of upholding this dharani, wherever I am born, I am always in the presence of the Buddha, born from a lotus transformation, and do not receive a body born from a womb.

chinese: 「若有比丘、比丘尼、優婆塞、優婆夷、童男、童女，欲誦持者，於諸眾生，起慈悲心，先當從我，發如是願：「『大悲觀世音！
english: "If there be bhikṣus, bhikṣuṇīs, upāsakas, upāsikās, boys, or girls who wish to recite and uphold this, they should, regarding all sentient beings, give rise to a heart of compassion and loving-kindness. First they should make the following vow before me: 'Great Compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

chinese: 願我速知一切法。
english: May I swiftly know all dharmas.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我早得智慧眼。
english: May I quickly obtain the eye of wisdom.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我速度一切眾。
english: May I quickly cross over all sentient beings.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我早得善方便。
english: May I quickly obtain skillful means.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我速乘般若船。
english: May I swiftly board the boat of prajna.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

chinese: 願我早得越苦海。
english: May I quickly cross over the ocean of suffering.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我速得戒定道。
english: "May I quickly attain the precepts, concentration, and the Way."

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我早登涅槃山。
english: "May I quickly ascend to the Mountain of Nirvana."

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我速會無為舍。
english: May I quickly meet the dwelling of non-action.

chinese: 南無大悲觀世音！
english: Homage to the Great Compassionate Avalokiteshvara!

chinese: 願我早同法性身。
english: May I soon attain a body identical with the Dharma-nature.

chinese: 「『我若向刀山，刀山自摧折。
english: "If I were to go toward a mountain of swords, the mountain of swords would crumble of itself.

chinese: 我若向火湯，火湯自消滅。
english: If I were to go into boiling water, the boiling water would extinguish itself.

chinese: 我若向地獄，地獄自枯竭。
english: If I were to go toward hell, hell itself would wither away.

chinese: 我若向餓鬼，餓鬼自飽滿。
english: If I were to turn toward hungry ghosts, the hungry ghosts would naturally become satisfied.

chinese: 我若向修羅，惡心自調伏。
english: If I incline toward the asuras, my evil mind will naturally be subdued.

chinese: 我若向畜生，自得大智慧。
english: If I were to turn toward animals, I would naturally obtain great wisdom.

chinese: 若有在家善男女等誦持之者，其家無有災橫病苦之所惱害，諸有所作無不諧偶，所言人皆信受。
english: If there are lay devotees, both men and women, who recite and uphold this [sutra], their households will be free from calamities, misfortunes, illnesses, and suffering that cause harm. All their undertakings will be harmonious and successful, and whatever they say, people will believe and accept.

chinese: 若有誦此陀羅尼呪滿十萬遍，夢中得見諸佛、菩薩、聲聞、緣覺，自見口中出黑。
english: If one chants this dharani mantra a hundred thousand times, in dreams one will see various Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, Sravakas, and Pratyekabuddhas, and one will see black [substances] coming out of one's own mouth.

chinese: 若有重罪，誦滿二十萬遍，夢中亦見諸佛菩薩，亦自出黑。
english: If one has committed grave sins, by reciting [this scripture] two hundred thousand times, one will see various Buddhas and Bodhisattvas even in dreams, and will also naturally emerge from darkness.

chinese: 若有五逆，不得如是善夢應更誦滿七十萬遍，是時還得如前之相。
english: If one commits the five heinous crimes, one will not receive such auspicious dreams as before. One should further recite the sutra until completing one million seven hundred thousand times, and only then will one again obtain the signs as previously described.

chinese: 乃至夢見出白色，當知此人即是罪滅清淨之相。
english: Even if one dreams of seeing white color, one should know that this person is indeed the sign of karmic sin being extinguished and purified.

chinese: 「復次我今說大陀羅尼所作之事。
english: "Moreover, I now speak of the deeds accomplished by this great dharani.

chinese: 若於佛像前、或於塔前、若清淨處，以瞿摩塗地而作方壇，隨其大小。
english: If before a Buddha image, or before a stupa, or in a clean place, one should purify the ground with cow dung and construct a square altar according to its size.

chinese: 復以花、香、幡蓋、食、，隨力所辦而供養之。
english: Again, with flowers, incense, banners, canopies, and food, they made offerings according to their means and ability.

chinese: 復呪香水散於四上下，以為結。
english:
# Translation

The recitation incense and water scattered in the four directions above and below, thereby forming a seal.

chinese: 於壇四角及壇中央，皆各置一香水之瓶。
english: At the four corners of the altar and in the center of the altar, fragrant water vessels are placed at each location.

chinese: 持呪之者於其壇中，面向東方跪，誦呪一千遍，其香水瓶即便自。
english:
The one who holds the mantra, kneeling in the center of the altar facing east, recites the mantra one thousand times, and thereupon the fragrant water bottle will of itself...

(Note: The text appears to be incomplete, as it ends with "即便自" which seems to be missing its object or complement.)

chinese: 叉手捧雜花，呪遍，散一鏡面；又於鏡前正，誦呪亦，得見佛菩薩像。
english:
# Translation

With crossed hands holding miscellaneous flowers, after reciting the incantation and scattering them across the mirror surface, and then straightening oneself before the mirror and reciting the incantation again, one was able to see images of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

chinese: 呪花八遍，而散供，請問無不決了。
english: "Recite the Mantra Flower eight times, and then scatter the offering. If you inquire, there will be nothing that is not resolved."

chinese: 若有鬼病，以茅而拂病人，即得除愈。
english: If someone has a disease caused by ghosts, by sweeping the afflicted person with mugwort, the disease will immediately be cured.

chinese: 若有幼小為鬼所著，以五色縷，應令童女以線，一呪一結滿二十，用繫其頸，芥子呪七遍，其面，即便除。
english: If a small child is possessed by a ghost, take five-colored threads and have a young girl tie knots while reciting an incantation, making twenty knots in total. Use this to tie around the child's neck. Recite the mustard seed incantation seven times over the face, and the possession will immediately be cured.

chinese: 「復次有法，於病者墨畫其，呪楊枝打，亦除。
english: "Furthermore, there is a method: for a sick person, draw with black ink on them, recite a spell over a willow branch and strike them with it, and it will also be cured."

chinese: 「復法，若有病人為鬼所著，身在遠處，應呪楊枝滿七遍，寄持打，即亦除。
english: "Furthermore, if there is a sick person possessed by a ghost while their body is in a distant place, one should chant a spell over a willow branch seven times, and then send someone to strike [the ghost] with it, and it will likewise be eliminated."

chinese: 「復法，若在路行，此呪，無有賊盜惡獸等。
english: "Moreover, if one recites this spell while traveling on the road, there will be no thieves, robbers, evil beasts, and the like."

chinese: 「復法，常持此呪，設有諍訟無不獲勝。
english: "Moreover, if one constantly upholds this mantra, even if there is litigation or dispute, one will surely obtain victory without fail."

chinese: 若欲往渡江河大海，誦呪而渡，無有水中惡獸等難。
english: If one wishes to cross rivers, great seas, and oceans, by reciting spells one can cross without encountering difficulties from evil beasts in the water.

chinese: 「復法，若被繫閉枷鎖其身，誦此呪者，即得解脫。
english: "Moreover, if one's body is bound and locked in stocks and chains, whoever recites this spell shall immediately gain liberation."

chinese: 「復法，若諸國土水旱不調、疫毒流，應以酥和胡麻、粳米，用手三指取其一撮，呪之一遍火中燒。
english: "Again, with regard to the dharma: if in various lands water and drought are not balanced, and pestilence and poison spread, one should take ghee mixed with sesame and polished rice, pinch a small amount with three fingers of the hand, recite the spell over it once, and burn it in fire."

chinese: 或經七日七夜，六時如是相續不絕，一切災疫消。
english: Or after seven days and seven nights, with such [recitation] continuing uninterrupted through the six periods [of day and night], all calamities and pestilences are eliminated.

chinese: 「復法，於河渚間砂潬之上，印印為塔形像，誦呪一遍印成一塔，六十萬遍，觀菩、或見多羅菩薩、金剛菩薩，心皆得滿足，或見授與藥，或見菩提之記。
english: "The method of restoration: On the sandbanks among the rivers, imprint upon the sandy ground in the form of a stupa. With each recitation of the dharani, one imprint becomes one stupa. After sixty thousand repetitions, [one will] perceive the Bodhisattvas, or see Tara Bodhisattva or Vajra Bodhisattva, and one's heart will be completely satisfied. Or [one will] see [them] bestowing medicine, or receive a prophecy of Bodhi."

chinese: 「復，右遶菩提樹像，誦呪滿千萬遍，即見菩薩為其說法，欲隨菩薩即得隨從。
english: "Again, circumambulate to the right around the image of the Bodhi tree, recite the dharani spell one hundred million times, and immediately you will see the Bodhisattva expound the dharma for you. If you wish to follow the Bodhisattva, you will immediately be able to do so."

chinese: 「復法，若乞食時常持此呪，不為惡人惡狗等類之所害。
english: "According to the restoration of the dharma, if one constantly holds this spell during the time of begging for alms, one will not be harmed by evil people, evil dogs, and the like."

chinese: 塔前或佛像前或舍利塔前，誦持此呪三十萬遍，於白月十五日設大供養，一日一夜不食正誦呪，得見金剛手菩薩，而彼菩薩即將是往於自宮。
english: Before the pagoda, or before the Buddha image, or before the reliquary stupa, recite and hold this dharani three hundred thousand times. On the fifteenth day of the white lunar fortnight, make a great offering. For one day and night, abstain from food and recite the dharani correctly. You will then see the Bodhisattva Vajrapani, and that Bodhisattva will then take you to his own palace.

chinese: 「復法，若於轉法輪塔前、或佛生處塔前、或忉利天下寶階塔前、或舍利塔前，於如是等諸塔之前誦呪右遶，即見阿鉢羅是多菩薩及訶利底菩薩，隨其所願皆悉滿足，若須仙藥即便授之，復為說法示菩薩道。
english: "Further, if before the stupa of the turning of the dharma wheel, or before the stupa at the place of the Buddha's birth, or before the jeweled staircase stupa below the Trayastrimsha heaven, or before the relic stupa, one recites mantras and circumambulates to the right before such stupas as these, one will immediately see the bodhisattva Apalara and the bodhisattva Hariti, and all their wishes will be fulfilled according to their desires. If they require celestial medicine, it will be bestowed upon them, and they will further expound the dharma and point out the path of the bodhisattva."

chinese: 若有誦此陀羅尼者，乃至未坐道場，一切菩薩為友。
english: If there is anyone who recites this dharani, until they have not yet sat upon the bodhi seat, all bodhisattvas will be their friends.

chinese: 又此准提大陀羅尼大明呪法，過去一切諸佛已說、、，我今亦如是說，為利一切眾生故、得無上菩提故。
english: Moreover, this Cundi Dharani, great magical formula, and illuminating mantra - all the Buddhas of the past have already expounded it. I too now expound it in the same way, for the sake of benefiting all sentient beings and for the sake of attaining unsurpassed Bodhi.

chinese: 若有薄福眾生，少善根者、無有根器之者、無有者，若得聞此羅尼法，速疾證得阿耨多羅三藐三菩提。
english: If there are sentient beings with scant blessings, few roots of goodness, those without capacity, or those who have nothing, if they can but hear this dharani teaching, they will swiftly and speedily attain anuttara-samyak-sambodhi (unsurpassed perfect enlightenment).

chinese: 若有人念，，無量善根皆得成就。
english: If there is someone who recites this, immeasurable wholesome roots will all be perfected and accomplished.

chinese: 」佛說此大准提陀羅尼法時，無量眾生遠塵離垢，得大准提陀羅尼大明呪功德，得見十方諸佛菩聖眾，作禮而去。
english: When the Buddha expounded this great Cundi Dharani method, countless beings transcended dust and separated from defilement, obtaining the merit and virtue of the great Cundi Dharani great luminous mantra. They were able to see the Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, and holy multitudes in all ten directions, made obeisance, and departed.

chinese: 爾時普賢菩薩得諸佛心印，即住金剛壽命三昧耶，於身毛孔中放無量微塵等數光遍十方界，以自在神通力即說陀羅尼曰：「怛儞也他者隷者攞者隷尾曩知娑縛悉底計斫羯誐爾鉢囉捨漫覩薩嚩路誐薩嚩娑怛嚩南阿曩句曩摩賀曩者隷者隷係摩誤憍哩係摩儞鏟禰係摩尸棄矯囉吠矯囉悌係俱囉吠俱囉俱囉摩底微捨摩寧摩寧戍毘嚩阿者梨微者梨摩尾覽嚩呼牟呼牟唵嚩日囉諭曬娑嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，大地山河悉皆振動，地獄摧碎、宮震動，病苦眾生當時蘇息。
english: At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva obtained the mind-seal of all Buddhas and immediately dwelt in the Diamond Lifespan Samadhi. From the pores of his body, he emitted immeasurable light equal in number to dust motes, pervading the ten directions of the dharma realm. By means of his sovereign supernatural powers, he spoke a dharani, saying: "Tadyatha varē varō varē vainōchi savah siddhē jhakaḍagōr parahśamantuh savasarugō savasasadavān anāh kunō mahānō varē varē kaimō mokhāraikh kaimō nīchānē kaimō shikhikyōrō vaikyōrō tīkh kurō vaikurō kurō mādhī viśmō nīng māning śhurvai var ā jaraih vijāraih māvilāh vah humuhumuṃ vajarē yushai savah hoh." Having spoken this dharani, the great earth, mountains, and rivers all trembled and vibrated. The hells were shattered, palaces shook, and the diseases and sufferings of sentient beings were immediately relieved.

chinese: 會中有無量執金剛神，異口同音亦共宣說，諸大菩薩摩訶薩眾悉助延命宣說陀羅尼，令獲金剛壽命。
english: In the assembly there were immeasurable Vajra-wielding deities who, with different mouths but the same voice, also proclaimed the teachings. All the great Bodhisattva-Mahasattvas together aided and extended the life-span by proclaiming dharanis, causing [beings] to obtain the vajra life-span.

chinese: 爾時十方塵沙諸佛心印加持，令普賢菩薩及四天王增得金剛壽命。
english: At that time, the Buddha-seals and sustaining power of countless Buddhas throughout the ten directions caused Samantabhadra Bodhisattva and the Four Heavenly Kings to receive an increase in their vajra-like eternal life.

chinese: 爾時世尊彈指讚嘆：「汝能快善利益眾生。
english: At that time, the World-Honored One snapped his fingers in praise and said: "You are able to swiftly and excellently benefit all sentient beings.

chinese: 若有善男子善女人，怖畏夭橫非命及不祥事，即以沐浴、著新淨衣、燒香散花，持我延命心真言，即增壽。
english: If there are virtuous men and virtuous women who fear premature death, violent death, untimely death, and inauspicious events, then by bathing, wearing clean new clothes, burning incense and scattering flowers, and holding my life-extending heart mantra, their lifespan will be increased.

chinese: 若有病苦眾生求長壽故，離於病苦，即建立道場於清淨屋舍或就伽藍，請三七比丘清淨僧，轉讀此經各四十九遍，別持是陀羅尼滿十萬遍，即獲壽命。
english: If there are sentient beings suffering from illness who seek long life in order to be free from sickness and pain, they should establish a ritual space in a pure dwelling or within a monastery, invite twenty-one pure monks, have them recite this sutra forty-nine times each, and separately recite this dharani one hundred thousand times. Thus they will attain longevity.

chinese: 病者即於夜夢，自見殊勝境界。
english: The patient immediately saw in a night dream a most excellent and sublime realm.

chinese: 我此延命法，先須彩書普賢菩薩，如滿月童子形，五佛頭冠，右手持金剛杵、左手持召集金剛鈴契，鬘縱緩帶，坐千葉寶華。
english: This prolongation-of-life method of mine requires first that one paint Samantabhadra Bodhisattva in the form of the Full Moon Child, wearing a crown with five Buddhas, holding a vajra scepter in the right hand and a summoning vajra bell in the left hand, with garlands and flowing scarves, seated upon a thousand-petaled jeweled lotus.

chinese: 下有白象王，象有三頭，鼻卷獨股杵，各具六牙。
english: Below there is a White Elephant King, the elephant has three heads, its trunks curl around a single pestle, each possessing six tusks.

chinese: 其象四足踏一大金剛輪。
english: Its image depicts four feet treading upon a great vajra wheel.

chinese: 輪下有五千群象，各負其輪。
english: Beneath the wheel were five thousand herds of elephants, each bearing its wheel.

chinese: 於菩薩身放百寶光，光外盡白。
english: From the Bodhisattva's body, a hundred-jeweled light was emitted, and the light outside was entirely white.

chinese: 月輪眾彩莊嚴，盡得其像。
english: The lunar wheel, resplendent with manifold colors and ornaments, fully captures its appearance.

chinese: 敬於清淨處建立道場，令清淨僧持是真言，及轉此經，乃至書寫及持金剛壽命陀羅尼滿十萬遍，即增壽命，除夭橫故。
english: Reverently establish a place of practice in a pure location, and have pure monks maintain this true word and transmit this sutra. Even those who write and uphold the Vajra Longevity Dharani up to one hundred thousand times will increase their lifespan and be freed from untimely and violent death.

chinese: 」爾時四天王等承佛加持，助普賢菩薩延命，各立誓言：「娑婆世界南贍部洲但有此經法流行之處，我等四王即為結護，令無夭橫。
english: At that time, the Four Heavenly Kings and others, receiving the Buddha's empowerment, assisted Samantabhadra Bodhisattva in extending his lifespan, and each made a vow, saying: "Wherever this dharma teaching circulates in the southern Jambudvīpa of the Sahā world, we Four Kings shall establish protection and safeguards, preventing untimely death and calamity."

chinese: 如有此經清淨道場，如不降赴，願我失此威光、損我果報，退失菩提心，不得解脫。
english: If there is such a scripture and a pure place of practice, and if I do not descend and arrive, may I lose this radiant glory, diminish my karmic rewards, abandon the bodhisattva mind, and fail to attain liberation.

chinese: 」爾時十方如來加持一切執金剛菩薩，異口同音亦說延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢吽吽尸棄娑嚩賀」如是說已，一切如來、十方執金剛菩薩隱於虛中已不現。
english: At that time, the Tathagatas of the ten directions empowered all the Vajradhara Bodhisattvas, who, with different mouths but unified voice, also recited the life-prolonging dharani, saying: "Om Vajrayoşe Hūm Hūm Śikhi Svāhā." After speaking thus, all the Tathagatas and the Vajradhara Bodhisattvas of the ten directions disappeared into the void and were seen no more.

chinese: 爾時毘沙門天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the Heavenly King Vaisravana respectfully addressed the Buddha, saying: "World Honored One!

chinese: 我亦以助佛神力加持護念，除非命故，說陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日囉諭勢。
english: I too shall aid with the Buddha's spiritual power, sustenance, and protection. Except in the case of death, I proclaim this dharani: "Om Vajra Yueshi."

chinese: 濕吠帝濕吠帝濕吠多隷理娑嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，令一切眾生獲得壽命，無夭橫故。
english: "Humid-bark Emperor, Humid-bark Emperor, Humid-bark many-slaves principle sva-ha." Having spoken this dharani, it causes all sentient beings to obtain longevity, being free from untimely and violent death.

chinese: 爾時毘樓勒叉天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the heavenly king Virūḍhaka spoke to the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 我亦以助佛神力，宣說延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢摩蹬儗摩蹬儗摩蹬儗儞輸摩輸謀嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，獲得壽命，無夭橫故。
english: I too shall assist with the Buddha's spiritual power and proclaim the life-extending dharani, saying: "Om vajra yusei mateng ni mateng ni mateng ni ni shumo shumou vahe." Having spoken this dharani, one obtains longevity and is free from premature or violent death.

chinese: 爾時毘樓博叉天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the heavenly king Virupaksha said to the Buddha: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 我亦以助佛神力故，助宣延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢者理者理者理隷」說是陀羅尼，令諸眾生獲金剛壽命，無夭橫故。
english: I too, by the power of assisting the Buddha, will proclaim and propagate the Life-Extending Dharani, saying: "Om vajra yuh sei ja ri ja ri ja ri li." By speaking this dharani, all sentient beings obtain the diamond-like lifespan and are free from premature and violent death.

chinese: 爾時提頭賴吒天王白佛言：「世尊！
english: At that time, the Heavenly King Dhritarashtra spoke to the Buddha, saying: "World-Honored One!

chinese: 我亦以佛神力，宣說延命陀羅尼曰：「唵嚩日羅諭勢未臨嚩嚩嚩娑嚩賀」說是陀羅尼已，令諸眾生獲金剛壽命，無夭橫故。
english: I too, by the Buddha's divine power, proclaim the life-extending dharani, saying: "Om vajra yuṣṭi-wei-lin vava-va svaha." Having spoken this dharani, I cause all sentient beings to obtain vajra life-span, free from untimely and unnatural death.

chinese: 爾時佛告四天王言：「若有眾生怖畏死難、病苦夭橫，有如是苦，但書寫此經受持讀誦，或別持此陀羅尼，或畫普賢延命像。
english: At that time the Buddha told the Four Heavenly Kings, saying: "If there are sentient beings who fear death, disaster, illness, suffering, and untimely death, and experience such sufferings as these, they need only write out this sutra, uphold and recite it, or separately uphold this dharani, or paint an image of Samantabhadra's life-extending form.

chinese: 作此方法，依月一日八日十五日建立道場，燒四十九燈，花香果藥各置十六器散於壇上，合掌禮拜高聲讚詠此陀羅尼及懺悔往咎，不墮三惡道，捨此身獲得金剛壽命，更不輪迴。
english: Following this method, establish a ritual space on the first, eighth, and fifteenth days of each month. Burn forty-nine lamps, and arrange sixteen vessels each of flowers, incense, fruit, and medicine scattered upon the altar. With palms joined in reverence and worship, recite aloud in praise this dharani and confess past transgressions. You will not fall into the three evil paths, and upon casting off this body, you will attain a diamond-like lifespan and will no longer transmigrate in the cycle of rebirth.

chinese: 若有比丘尼及四眾，轉讀此經而不廢忘，離於短命夭橫之怖，及夜惡夢厭魅呪咀、惡形羅剎鳥鳴百怪之屬，亦不為水火兵毒之所傷害。
english: If there are bhiksunis and the four assemblies who continuously read and recite this sutra without abandoning or forgetting it, they will be freed from the fear of untimely death and violent calamities, as well as from nightmares, evil dreams, demonic oppression, curses, malevolent apparitions, rakshasas, inauspicious bird calls, and the hundred kinds of strange occurrences. They will also not be harmed by water, fire, weapons, or poison.

chinese: 一切諸佛及大菩薩攝受護念，亦得諸佛之所護念。
english: All the Buddhas and great Bodhisattvas embrace and protect with mindfulness, and also receive the protection and mindfulness of all the Buddhas.

chinese: 」爾時世尊說是經已，菩薩摩訶薩、天人、四眾及毘沙門天王等一切大眾，皆大歡喜信受奉行。
english: At that time, when the World-Honored One had finished expounding this sutra, the bodhisattva-mahasattvas, devas, humans, the fourfold assembly, and Vaisravana, the heavenly king, and all the great multitude were filled with great joy, and faithfully accepted and practiced it.

chinese: 」時即佛微告馬鳴菩薩言：「善哉！
english: At that time, the Buddha subtly instructed the Bodhisattva Aśvaghoṣa, saying: "Excellent!

chinese: 大丈夫！
english:
That's okay! / Don't worry! / It's fine!

(Or more literally: "A great man!" - but in modern usage, it's an expression meaning everything is alright.)

chinese: 汝速可說可說。
english: "You should quickly explain what can be explained."

chinese: 」「唯然。
english: "Just so."

chinese: 世尊愍念我聽說。
english: The World-Honored One, taking pity on me, heard my words.

chinese: 」合掌歡喜從口中放大光明，說光中神呪曰：「曩謨三曼多沒他那迦迦馬鳴吃哩吒囉佉吒囉佉莎縛訶」「若欲受持此法，先從師盡財利布施供給，受習印契真言。

"If one wishes to uphold and maintain this dharma, one must first make offerings of all one's wealth and resources to the teacher, and receive instruction in the mudras and mantras.

chinese: 則畫作菩薩像，色相白肉色而合掌，坐白蓮華，乘白馬，著白色衣，以瓔珞莊嚴身，首戴花冠，垂右足。
english: Then [he] painted [her] as a Bodhisattva image, with a fair complexion and flesh-colored [skin], with palms joined together, seated on a white lotus flower, riding a white horse, dressed in white garments, adorned with necklaces and ornaments on the body, wearing a flowered crown on the head, with the right foot hanging down.

chinese: 畫像了，泥壇。
english: "The portrait is finished, clay altar."

chinese: 始自三月三日，東面像向西，以種種廣大供具、蘇乳蘇燈供養。
english: Beginning from the third day of the third month, [with the] eastern image facing west, [they] make offerings with all kinds of extensive and elaborate offerings, ghee, butter, and oil lamps.

chinese: 二十八日乃至百日，須清淨潔淨。
english: From the twenty-eighth day up to one hundred days, [one] must maintain purity and cleanliness.

chinese: 比丘及傳法利生之師，恩不已失，時我常檀那家及國土放大光明，成就錦繡羅綿財絹縺緻之類，金寶積如山岳，世間受用咨。
english:
# Translation

Bhikṣus and teachers who transmit the Dharma and benefit sentient beings—their kindness is never exhausted. At such times, I constantly cause the families of my donors and their lands to emit great radiance, and accomplish silken fabrics, brocades, fine linens, and similar precious materials. Gold and treasures accumulate like mountains and peaks, and the world enjoys abundant resources and provisions.

chinese: 「若有一國一人修行，我本誓故，普天率土民家皆悉如前所說，財利莊嚴具成就。
english: "If there is one country or one person who practices [the way], because of my original vow, all the common people throughout the land will all, just as previously explained, achieve the accomplishment of wealth, prosperity, and adornment."

chinese: 一人莫乏有患，我本願皆悉為莊嚴財寶。
english: One person should not lack support; I vow to provide all beings with adornments and treasures.

chinese: 於若法至疑惑之心，發起不信之念，不成就一世之願故，後世之果不定。
english: Those who develop doubt and skepticism toward the Dharma, and generate thoughts of disbelief, will not fulfill the vows of this life, and therefore the fruits of future lives will be uncertain.

chinese: 好好以堅固之情歸於法，非忌傳授之德，我必日日時時加護念，圓滿世間第一妙樂之財利。
english:
# Translation

Sincerely return to the Dharma with firm devotion, not envying the virtue of transmission. I will definitely protect and care for you constantly, day and night, and bring about the fulfillment of the most wondrous and supreme happiness and benefit in the world.

chinese: 如向所說，係念本誓，向寶壇前作契印念誦。
english: As mentioned before, mindfully recite the original vow and perform the covenant seal gesture before the precious altar while chanting.

chinese: 屈左中指無名指，以大母指押彼二指甲，舒頭指及小指安心上，右手把數珠念真言，此名玉環成就一切所願印。
english: Bend the left middle finger and ring finger, and press their nails with the thumb. Extend the index finger and little finger and place them on the heart. With the right hand hold the prayer beads and recite the true words. This is called the Jade Ring Mudra that accomplishes all wishes.

chinese: 此契印，末代愚學之妄，不可記於文字。
english: This seal/contract is the delusion of a foolish scholar of the final age, and cannot be recorded in written characters.

chinese: 萬人中撰十人，十人之中撰一人，許可。
english: From ten thousand people, select ten; from these ten, select one. This is permissible.

english: The painter should observe eight precepts, among which is not to use animal-skin glue in the pigments.

chinese: 復以甘脆飲食、乳糜酪飯及諸菓子、閼伽香水，燒沈水香而供養。

english: The image faces west, the practitioner faces east, and recites facing the image. Three times daily, reciting one thousand times at each session.

chinese: 取月生五日起首，先誦萬遍，然後對像前念誦，所求一切事皆悉圓滿。
english: Beginning from the fifth day after the moon's birth, first recite ten thousand times, and then chant before the image. All matters that are sought will be completely fulfilled.

chinese: 「又法女人欲得男女者，月經後澡浴，取黃母子同色者，乳一升置銀器中。
english: "Furthermore, if a woman desires to conceive male or female children, after her menstrual period she should bathe, take the milk of a yellow mother [animal] and its offspring of the same color, [and place] one sheng of milk in a silver vessel.

chinese: 以右手無名指攪乳，誦真言加持一千八十遍，然後取服，至日內則得有胎。
english: Using the right hand's ring finger to stir the milk, recite the true mantra with empowerment one thousand eighty times, then take it. Within that day one will obtain pregnancy.

chinese: 「又法欲令他人歡喜敬愛者，或飲食菓子或華或香加持一百八遍，於真言句中加彼人名，將與彼人，則得歡喜。
english: "Moreover, there is another method: if one wishes to cause others to be delighted and respectful in their love, one should empower food and fruit, flowers, or incense with one hundred and eight recitations, adding the name of that person within the mantra phrases, then give it to that person, and they will become delighted."

chinese: 「又法若有人作留難口舌者，畫彼人形，左脚踏之，誦真言一千八十遍則得無難。
english: "Furthermore, if there is someone who creates obstacles and slanders with their mouth and tongue, draw the form of that person, step on it with the left foot, and recite the mantra one thousand eighty times, and then one will be free from obstacles."

chinese: 「又法欲令一切人歡喜，取牛黃末置銀器中，准前以無名指攪，誦真言加持一百八遍，點於額上，一切人見皆歡喜順伏。
english: "Furthermore, if one wishes to cause all people to be delighted, take powdered ox gallstone, place it in a silver vessel, and stir it with the ring finger according to the previous method. Recite the true words and empower it one hundred and eight times, then apply it to the forehead. All people who see it will be delighted and obedient."

chinese: 「又法若新衣服，對像前加持一百八遍，然後取著，一切人見亦皆歡喜敬愛。
english: "Another method: if [you have] new clothes, perform the mantra recitation one hundred and eight times facing an image [of a deity], then wear them. All people who see [you] will be delighted, respectful, and affectionate."

chinese: 「又法若有惡夢，誦真言一百八遍，則得惡夢消除。
english: "Moreover, if there is a bad dream, by reciting the true mantra one hundred and eight times, the bad dream will be eliminated."

chinese: 「又法若月蝕時，取酥五兩置器中，以金筯攪，無間斷念誦加持，乃至月却得圓滿為限。

english: Then take one portion to make an offering to Hariti, the mother of demons. Consume the remainder gradually, and you will conceive. The sons and daughters born will be intelligent, wise, and blessed with virtue.

chinese: 又法取牛膝根作齒木，加持一百八遍嚼及揩齒，所出言詞令人樂聞，意欲所求他人之事皆得隨意成就。
english:
# Translation

Furthermore, another method: take the root of Chinese motherwort and fashion it into a toothpick. Empower it with one hundred and eight repetitions, then chew with it and rub the teeth. The words that come forth will cause people to delight in listening. Whatever one wishes to request of others will all be accomplished according to one's intentions.

chinese: 又法欲得壽命長遠者，取骨屢草嫩苗搵蘇蜜酪護摩七夜，夜別誦真言一千八，火中則長壽。
english:
# Translation

Furthermore, there is another method: those who wish to obtain a long life should take tender sprouts of bonelu grass, soak them in sesame honey and ghee, and perform the fire ritual (homa) for seven nights. On each night, recite the true mantra one thousand eight hundred times in the fire, and this will result in longevity.

chinese: 「又法欲得所為所作隨意成就者，每月生五日二十日，塗道場散華，種種飲食乳糜酪飯及諸菓子、閼伽香水，燒沈香薰陸以用供養。
english: "Furthermore, if one wishes that whatever one undertakes and whatever work one does shall be accomplished according to one's wishes, then on the fifth and twentieth days of each month, one should purify the ritual space, scatter flowers, prepare various foods including milk-porridge, curds, rice, and all manner of fruits and confections, consecrated water, and burn sandalwood and frankincense to make offerings."

chinese: 先供養一切如來、文殊師利菩薩、普賢等一切菩薩，然後供養我訶利帝母。
english: First make offerings to all Tathagatas, Manjushri Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra and all other Bodhisattvas, and then make offerings to me, Hariti Mother.

chinese: 何以故？
english: Why is that?

chinese: 我本藥叉女，如來與我三歸五戒菩提心律儀戒，對諸十地菩薩故，是先供養諸佛菩薩。
english: I was originally a yakṣa woman. The Tathāgata gave me the three refuges, the five precepts, and the bodhisattva heart precepts and moral discipline. In the presence of the bodhisattvas of all ten grounds, I first make offerings to all buddhas and bodhisattvas.

chinese: 供養已，對此像前誦一萬遍，所求事業皆得滿足。
english: After making offerings, recite [this sutra/mantra] ten thousand times before this image, and all sought-after endeavors will be completely fulfilled.

chinese: 「訶利帝母念誦法。
english: "The Recitation Method of Hariti, Mother of Demons."

chinese: 「愛子心真言：「知尾知娑嚩」「印，合掌屈二大拇指入掌中，誦心真言供養訖，於頂上放二大拇指即散去。

chinese: 請召、發遣皆此印。
english: "Both summons and dispatch orders used this seal."

english: Using white sandalwood, measure six fingers in length to make the form of a child, complete with two hands, each holding a fruit to give to people, with three tufts of hair on the head.

english:
"Answered according to what was in his mind."

or

english: Take yellow ox meat the size of a square inch, recite a mantra over one portion and burn one portion, three times daily, after four days one attains great freedom and ability to act at will.

chinese: 「又法牛肉、香為丸，月八日時念誦，燒上香八遍。
english: "Furthermore, the method is: make pills from beef and fragrance. At the eighth day of the month, during that time recite and chant, then burn the incense above eight times."

english: When the solstice arrived, at midnight there appeared a great luminous phenomenon, and he obtained great divine power.

chinese: 安香為丸，一加持一燒，日三時，時別一千八遍，五日調伏一切人。

Make pills with aromatic powder. For each batch, perform one mantra recitation and one burning. Three times daily, recite one thousand and eight times each session. After five days, subdue all people.

english: "Another method: recite the mantra over milk porridge, one [portion] with mantra recitation and one burned for seven days, three times daily, each time one thousand eight hundred recitations separately, [and he will] appear in person to converse and answer your questions."

english: To cure disease, infuse and empower the mango fruit, steep and burn [it] in milk with empowerment, [this] eliminates all diseases.

"Next, one should move the seal and press it upon that navel center, visualizing the wheel with a circular form of black color, and recite the mantra seven times saying: 'Vainava-kula-nana-va-ho'

"Next, one should apply the great seal to the two feet of that one, visualizing the garuda, and recite the mantra saying: 'Paksi-la-rabana-va-ho'

"Next, one should apply the great seal and recite the armor mantra, empowering the young maiden, rotating throughout the entire body."

chinese: 真言曰：「迦嚩左部多地跛帝嚩」「行者次應自身為醯首羅天，三目，頭冠瓔珞莊嚴，頭冠上有佛半月，上青，十八臂，手持種種器仗。
english: The true words (mantra) say: "Kavaśabuddhataipadiha." The practitioner should next visualize themselves as Maheshvara Heaven, with three eyes, the head adorned with a crown of pearls and ornaments, with a half-moon Buddha on top of the crown, blue above, eighteen arms, holding various implements and weapons in the hands.

chinese: 以龍為線，角絡繫。
english: With dragons as threads, horns interconnected and bound.

chinese: 又塗血，須臾頃觀自身已，次應以大印護彼童女一百八命節。
english: "Again anoint with blood, and in a moment observe your own body. Next you should protect the one hundred and eight vital points of that maiden with the great seal."

chinese: 真言曰：「唵哩體尾吒多惹囉迦」「結其大印及誦真言，遍身旋繞加持，則護八種命節。
english: The true word says: "Om ri ti wei zha ta ra ra ka." "Bind the great seal and recite the true word, circumambulating throughout the body with empowerment, thus protecting the eight vital nodes of life."

chinese: 「次又以大印真言加持花香及閼伽等。
english: "Next, further [one should] empower flowers, incense, and scented water, etc., using the great seal mantra."

chinese: 「又以大印真言結十方界，則應對此童女前誦醯首羅使者真言曰：「唎躋吒迦麼多那誐尾灑娜拏薩摩那誐囉尾訖囉摩尾羅薩誐底濟吒迦布囉哩擔囕左左左左拏拏尼尼伴爾伴爾羯恥羯恥阿尾捨阿尾捨躋吒迦嚕奴孃跋野嚩賀」「此真言應誦七遍，則彼童女戰動，當知聖者入身，則更彈指誦真言。
english: "Moreover, by sealing the ten directions of the world with the great seal mantra, one should then recite before this maiden the mantra of the Acyuta messenger, saying: 'Li ji cha ka mo to na ge wei sha na na sa mo na ge la wei ji la mo wei lo sa ge di ji cha ka bu la li dan lu zuo zuo zuo zuo na na ni ni ban er ban er ge chi ge chi a wei she a wei she ji cha ka lu nu niang ba ye vuo ho.' This mantra should be recited seven times, and then that maiden will tremble. When you know that the sage has entered the body, snap your fingers again and recite the mantra."

chinese: 若無現驗，次誦迫使者真言曰：「耶摩呬多素囉素囉布爾多賀那賀那囉憾麼那尼那覩嚕尼嚕尼謨尼謨尼伴爾伴爾羯恥羯恥阿尾阿尾躋吒迦嚕奴枳孃跛野帝嚩訶」「誦此真言必速應驗。
english: If there is no manifest effect, then recite the mantra of the messenger of force as follows: "Yama hṛdaya sura sura burda hana hana rahan mama nani natu ru ni ru ni namo ni namo ni pan ar pan ar gadhi gadhi awi awi chi cha ka ru nu ki nyang pa ye di va ha." When you recite this mantra, a swift manifestation of effects is certain to occur.

chinese: 問未來善惡一切災，若不語或語遲，則結棒印。
english: "If questioned about all future calamities of good and evil, should one not speak or speak late, then the stick and seal will be applied as punishment."

chinese: 「二手合掌，二無名指外，二中指並立，二頭指各鉤無名指頭，二大指各令押中交。
english: "Two hands in prayer position, with the two ring fingers extended outward, the two middle fingers standing together, the two index fingers each hooked onto the head of the ring finger, and the two thumbs each pressing down on the crossing middle fingers."

chinese: 誦真言曰：「唵母那誐囉都嚕都嚕娑嚩賀」「結此棒印，則問種種事已，以大印真言加持閼伽，三灑童女面，即結解。
english: "Recite the true words, saying: 'Om mana gala duru duru svaha.' Form this staff mudra, then having inquired about various matters, empower the water vessel with the great mudra true words, sprinkle three times upon the maiden's face, and immediately the binding is released."

chinese: 此使者真言，先應誦一萬遍則法成，則見身來，須獻閼伽乞願：『願聖者一切處一切時使用皆辦。
english: "This messenger's true words—if one first recites them ten thousand times, the rite will be accomplished and one will see the body appear. Then one must offer argha and make a vow, saying: 'May the holy one be able to accomplish all actions at all places and at all times.'"

chinese: 』則隱不現。
english: "Then it conceals and does not manifest."

chinese: 已後欲使，塗一小壇著香花飲食，誦真言一百八遍，則現身。
english: Hereafter, when you wish to summon [them], prepare a small altar, apply fragrant flowers and food offerings, recite the true words (mantra) one hundred eight times, and [they] will manifest their bodies.

chinese: 則言龍宮中取長年藥、如意寶珠，或使夜摩王處延命增益壽命，或使取妙甘露，或使他國問其善惡，亦能助軍陣摧破他敵，種種使用悉能成辦。
english: He spoke of taking long-life medicine and wish-fulfilling jewels from the Dragon Palace, or sending [someone] to the realm of the Yāma king to extend life and increase lifespan, or having them fetch the wonderful ambrosia, or sending [them] to other lands to inquire about the virtue and vice [of others], and [he said that such beings] are also able to assist in military formations to defeat enemies of others—in all manner of uses, [they] are able to accomplish [them].

chinese: 此法一切迦樓羅法中最殊勝，祕密難得。
english: This dharma is the most supreme among all the dharmas of Garuda, [and is] secret and difficult to obtain.

chinese: 汝當揀擇法器堪傳授者而傳與，即損他，已後此法不成。
english: You should select suitable dharma vessels capable of receiving transmission and transmit to them. If you harm others, this dharma will not be perfected in the future.

chinese: 是故應極祕密，勿妄傳之。
english: Therefore, it should be kept extremely secret; do not transmit it recklessly.

chinese: 大自在天迦樓羅陀羅尼曰：「那謨婆伽嚩底嚕馱囉野瞋那劫波野薩嚩微那延迦囉薩嚩羯摩莎馱那薩嚩嚩尸迦野薩嚩設嚕尾那捨那野唵迦波羅質擔瞋迦波羅部擔嚕訥嚕枳孃帝嚩」「此陀羅尼，調伏人取芭蕉葉畫彼人，心上書名字，誦陀羅尼一百八遍，即埋牛糞中，即調伏。
english:
"The Dharani of Mahesvara Garuda Tara is as follows: 'Namo bhagavate Rudra Raya Chinna Kalpaya Sarva Vina Yenika Ra Sarva Karma Shadana Sarva Vashika Ya Sarva Shelu Vina Shana Ya Om Kapa Ra Chutam Chinna Kapa Ra Bu Tam Rulu Rukti Nandi Vam.'

"To subdue a person using this dharani: Take a banana leaf and draw that person on it. Write their name on the heart of the figure. Recite the dharani one hundred and eight times, then bury it in cow dung, and the person will be subdued."

chinese: 欲令竪子對相憎，多羅葉畫彼男女形，書名相背，取線，取鼠狼毛、山鷄毛、蛇退皮燒熏，誦陀羅尼一百八遍，安劫波羅中，即於屍林中埋著，便相憎。
english: To make servants hate each other, paint the forms of a man and woman on a palm leaf with their names written back-to-back. Take thread and the hair of a mole, the feathers of a mountain pheasant, and shed snake skin, burn and fumigate them. Recite the dharani one hundred and eight times, place it in a kapala, and bury it in a charnel ground, and they will immediately come to hate each other.

chinese: 除却依舊。
english: Except for what remains the same.

chinese: 若令相憐者，還於多羅葉上畫彼形，書名相合，取白線繫，取雀兒毛、蛇皮燒熏，誦陀羅尼一百八遍，即相憐。
english: If you wish to make people affectionate toward each other, draw their forms on palm leaves, write their names together, bind them with white thread, take feathers of sparrows and snake skin, burn them as incense, recite the dharani one hundred and eight times, and they will become affectionate toward each other.

chinese: 「又法欲令人相打，於大皮或於牛皮，畫二人相把頭髻，書名著，取線纏著，於火上，埋碓臼下，即得日日相打，除劫止。
english: "Another method: if you want to make people fight with each other, draw two people grasping each other's hair on a large piece of leather or cowhide, write their names on it, bind it with thread, place it over fire, and bury it under a mortar. Then they will fight each other daily until the curse is lifted."

chinese: 「又法若欲調伏人者，取貝多葉上畫人形、書名，誦陀羅尼一百八遍，即於床下埋，即得調伏。
english: "Furthermore, if one wishes to subdue a person, take a leaf of the pattra tree, draw the figure of a person on it and write his name. Recite the dharani one hundred and eight times, then bury it beneath the bed, and one will immediately succeed in subduing that person."

chinese: 「又法令尿血者，取多羅葉畫彼人，書姓名，取釘誦陀羅尼一百八遍釘上，七七日即得除去。
english: "Moreover, according to another method, for those who urinate blood, take a palmyra leaf and draw upon it [an image of] that person, write their name, take a nail and recite the dharani one hundred and eight times while driving the nail [into the leaf], and after forty-nine days it will be cured and removed."

chinese: 「次說眼藥法。
english: "Next, the method of eye medicine is explained.

chinese: 若調伏竪子者，取蛇頭、竭羅安善那、青木香、甲蜂二，於黑月十四日擣作，和肉點眼角，一切竪子隨逐，天上亦來，非但人。
english: If one wishes to subdue boys, take a snake's head, desiccated larva, green agarwood, and two armored bees. Pound them together on the fourteenth day of the dark moon and mix with flesh. Apply to the corner of the eye, and all boys will follow after you. Even those from heaven will come—not merely human beings.
